from django.db import models
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _
from django.utils import timezone
from core.managers import CompanyManager

class PurchaseOrder(models.Model):
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('draft', _('Nacrt')), ('sent', _('Poslano')), ('confirmed', _('Potvrdjeno')),
        ('partial', _('Djelomicno isporuceno')), ('received', _('Isporuceno')),
        ('invoiced', _('Fakturirano')), ('cancelled', _('Otkazano')),
    ]
    PRIORITY_CHOICES = [
        ('low', _('Nizak')), ('normal', _('Normalan')),
        ('high', _('Visok')), ('urgent', _('Hitno')),
    ]
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE, null=True, blank=True)
    objects = CompanyManager()
    po_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, unique=True)
    supplier = models.ForeignKey('partners.Partner', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='purchase_orders')
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='draft')
    priority = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=PRIORITY_CHOICES, default='normal')
    order_date = models.DateField(default=timezone.now)
    expected_delivery = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    actual_delivery = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    subtotal = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    tax_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True, default='')
    internal_note = models.TextField(blank=True, default='')
    matched_invoice = models.ForeignKey('invoicing.Invoice', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='matched_po')
    match_status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=[
        ('unmatched', 'Neupareno'), ('matched', 'Upareno'),
        ('mismatch', 'Nepodudaranje'), ('approved', 'Odobreno'),
    ], default='unmatched')
    match_diff_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='po_created')
    approved_by = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='po_approved')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'Narudzbenica'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Narudzbenice'
        ordering = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.po_number} - {self.supplier or 'N/A'}"

    def generate_po_number(self):
        year = timezone.now().year
        last = PurchaseOrder.objects.filter(po_number__startswith=f'PO-{year}-').order_by('-po_number').first()
        seq = 1
        if last:
            try: seq = int(last.po_number.split('-')[-1]) + 1
            except Exception: pass
        return f'PO-{year}-{seq:04d}'

    def recalculate(self):
        from django.db.models import Sum
        agg = self.items.aggregate(sub=Sum('line_total'), tax=Sum('line_tax'))
        self.subtotal = agg['sub'] or 0
        self.tax_amount = agg['tax'] or 0
        self.total = self.subtotal + self.tax_amount
        self.save(update_fields=['subtotal', 'tax_amount', 'total', 'updated_at'])


class PurchaseOrderItem(models.Model):
    purchase_order = models.ForeignKey(PurchaseOrder, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='items')
    inventory_item = models.ForeignKey('inventory.InventoryItem', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True)
    description = models.CharField(max_length=500)
    sku = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default='')
    quantity = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=3)
    unit = models.CharField(max_length=20, default='kom')
    unit_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=4)
    tax_rate = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=25)
    line_total = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    line_tax = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    quantity_received = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=3, default=0)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'Stavka narudzbenice'

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.line_total = self.quantity * self.unit_price
        self.line_tax = self.line_total * (self.tax_rate / __import__("decimal").Decimal("100"))
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)


class SupplierPriceList(models.Model):
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE, null=True, blank=True)
    objects = CompanyManager()
    supplier = models.ForeignKey('partners.Partner', on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='price_lists')

    agreed_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=4)
    valid_from = models.DateField(default=timezone.now)
    valid_until = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    min_quantity = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=3, default=1)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.db import models
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _

from companies.models import Company
from core.managers import CompanyManager
from documents.models import Document
from partners.models import Partner


class TransactionCategory(models.Model):

    class CategoryType(models.TextChoices):
        INCOME = 'income', _('Prihod')
        EXPENSE = 'expense', _('Rashod')
        BOTH = 'both', _('Prihod i rashod')

    name = models.CharField(max_length=100, unique=True, verbose_name=_('Naziv kategorije'))
    category_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=10,
        choices=CategoryType.choices,
        default=CategoryType.BOTH,
        verbose_name=_('Tip'),
    )
    code = models.CharField(max_length=20, unique=True, verbose_name=_('Šifra'), help_text=_('Kratka oznaka (npr. SALES, RENT, SALARY)'))
    description = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Opis'))
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name=_('Aktivna'))
    sort_order = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(default=0, verbose_name=_('Redoslijed'))

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Kategorija transakcije')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Kategorije transakcija')
        ordering = ['sort_order', 'name']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.code} – {self.name}"


class Transaction(models.Model):
    DIRECTION_CHOICES = [
        ('income', _('Uplata / Prihod')),
        ('expense', _('Isplata / Rashod')),
    ]

    company   = models.ForeignKey(Company, on_delete=models.CASCADE, verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'))
    objects   = CompanyManager()
    partner   = models.ForeignKey(Partner, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name='transactions', verbose_name=_('Partner'))
    document  = models.ForeignKey(Document, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
                                   related_name='transactions', verbose_name=_('Vezani dokument'))

    # Nova veza na račun (za automatsku rekoncilaciju)
    invoice   = models.ForeignKey(
        'invoicing.Invoice', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='transactions',
        verbose_name=_('Vezani račun'),
    )

    # Kategorija
    category  = models.ForeignKey(
        TransactionCategory, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('Kategorija'),
    )

    amount    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Iznos'))
    tax_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Iznos PDV-a'))
    direction = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=DIRECTION_CHOICES, verbose_name=_('Smjer'))

    date      = models.DateField(verbose_name=_('Datum transakcije'))
    value_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Datum valute'))
    description = models.CharField(max_length=255, verbose_name=_('Opis'))
    reference = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Referenca / Poziv na broj'))

    # Račun na koji je plaćeno / s kojeg je plaćeno
    payment_account = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Platni račun (IBAN/blagajna)'))

    # Rekoncilacija
    is_reconciled = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Rekoncilirano'))

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Transakcija')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Transakcije')
        ordering = ['-date', '-created_at']

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self.partner_id:
            raise ValidationError('Svaka financijska transakcija mora biti vezana uz Partnera.')
        # Auto-reconcile if invoice is set and amount matches
        if self.invoice_id and not self.is_reconciled:
            try:
                if self.invoice.total == self.amount:
                    self.is_reconciled = True
            except Exception:
                pass
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.date} – {self.amount} ({self.get_direction_display()})"

from django.db import models


class Product(models.Model):
    """
    Polymorphic Product — single model for ALL domains.
    FOOD: HACCP expiry, packaging enforcement, kalo
    OPTICS: medical attributes (SPH, CYL), no HACCP
    EQUIPMENT: standard stock, no special rules
    SERVICE: no stock tracking
    """
    CATEGORY_CHOICES = [
        ('FOOD', 'Hrana / Grosmarkt'),
        ('OPTICS', 'Optika / Medicinski'),
        ('EQUIPMENT', 'Oprema / Alat'),
        ('SERVICE', 'Usluga'),
        ('OTHER', 'Ostalo'),
    ]

    company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='webshop_products',
        verbose_name='Tvrtka',
    )
    sku = models.CharField(max_length=100, unique=True, verbose_name='SKU')
    name = models.CharField(max_length=300, verbose_name='Naziv')
    description = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name='Opis')
    category = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=CATEGORY_CHOICES, default='OTHER',
        verbose_name='Domenski tip',
    )
    price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name='Cijena')
    stock = models.IntegerField(default=0, verbose_name='Zaliha (legacy)')
    available_qty = models.IntegerField(default=0, verbose_name='Dostupna kolicina')
    is_rental = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name='Za iznajmljivanje')
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name='Aktivno')
    image = models.ImageField(upload_to='products/', blank=True, verbose_name='Slika')
    inventory_item = models.OneToOneField(
        'inventory.InventoryItem',
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='webshop_product',
        verbose_name='Artikl iz zalihe',
    )

    # Domain-specific JSONB attributes
    # FOOD: {"kalo_percent": 2.0}
    # OPTICS: {"requires_sph": true, "requires_cyl": false, "requires_ax": false}
    domain_attrs = models.JSONField(default=dict, blank=True, verbose_name='Domenski atributi')

    # FOOD-specific
    expiry_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name='Rok trajanja')
    packaging_unit = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, verbose_name='Ambalaza')
    packaging_capacity_kg = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True,
        verbose_name='Kapacitet ambalaze (kg)',
    )

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'webshop_product'
        verbose_name = 'Proizvod'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Proizvodi'
        ordering = ['name']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"[{self.category}] {self.name} ({self.sku})"

    @property
    def is_expired(self):
        if not self.expiry_date:
            return False
        from datetime import date
        return self.expiry_date < date.today()

    @property
    def is_food(self):
        return self.category == 'FOOD'

    @property
    def is_optics(self):
        return self.category == 'OPTICS'

import uuid
from django.db import models
from django.conf import settings

class TrackingStatus(models.Model):
    TRACKING_TYPES = [
        ('food_order', 'Narudzba hrane'),
        ('delivery', 'Dostava'),
        ('intervention', 'Hitna intervencija'),
        ('work_order', 'Radni nalog'),
        ('expiry', 'Istek roka'),
        ('shipment', 'Otpremnica / Isporuka'),
    ]
    tracking_type = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=TRACKING_TYPES)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    slug = models.SlugField(max_length=100)
    order = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    icon = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True)
    color = models.CharField(max_length=20, default='#c9a84c')

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['tracking_type', 'order']
        unique_together = ['tracking_type', 'slug']
        verbose_name = 'Status pracenja'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Statusi pracenja'

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.get_tracking_type_display()} / {self.name}'


class TrackedItem(models.Model):
    content_type = models.ForeignKey(
        ContentType, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
    )
    object_id = models.CharField(max_length=64)
    content_object = GenericForeignKey('content_type', 'object_id')

    tracking_type = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=TrackingStatus.TRACKING_TYPES)
    current_status = models.ForeignKey(
        TrackingStatus, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='tracked_items',
    )
    latitude = models.DecimalField(max_digits=9, decimal_places=6, null=True, blank=True)
    longitude = models.DecimalField(max_digits=9, decimal_places=6, null=True, blank=True)
    public_token = models.CharField(max_length=32, unique=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'Praceni objekt'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Praceni objekti'

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.get_tracking_type_display()} #{self.pk}'

    # Logistics fields (used for shipment tracking type)
    driver_name   = models.CharField('Vozač', max_length=100, blank=True)
    vehicle_plate = models.CharField('Registracija', max_length=20, blank=True)
    tracking_url  = models.URLField('Vanjski tracking link', blank=True)
    DELIVERY_METHOD_CHOICES = [
        ('internal', 'Vlastito vozilo'),
        ('bus', 'Autobusna linija'),
        ('taxi', 'Taxi / brza dostava'),
        ('crowd', 'Crowd-shipping'),
        ('courier', 'Kurirska sluzba'),
        ('pickup', 'Osobno preuzimanje'),
    ]
    delivery_method = models.CharField(
        'Nacin dostave', max_length=20,
        choices=DELIVERY_METHOD_CHOICES, blank=True,
    )

    dispatched_at = models.DateTimeField('Polazak', null=True, blank=True)
    delivered_at  = models.DateTimeField('Isporuka', null=True, blank=True)

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self.public_token:
            self.public_token = uuid.uuid4().hex[:32]
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def update_status(self, new_status, user=None, note=''):
        self.current_status = new_status
        self.save(update_fields=['current_status', 'updated_at'])
        return TrackingEvent.objects.create(
            tracked_item=self,
            status=new_status,
            user=user,
            note=note,
        )

import uuid
from django.db import models
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _
from django.utils import timezone
from core.managers import CompanyManager

class Ticket(models.Model):
    CATEGORY_CHOICES = [
        ('delivery', _('Dostava')), ('quality', _('Kvaliteta robe')),
        ('invoice', _('Racun')), ('pos', _('POS/Blagajna')),
        ('technical', _('Tehnicki problem')), ('complaint', _('Reklamacija')),
        ('feature', _('Zahtjev')), ('other', _('Ostalo')),
    ]
    PRIORITY_CHOICES = [
        ('low', _('Nizak')), ('normal', _('Normalan')),
        ('high', _('Visok')), ('urgent', _('Hitno')), ('critical', _('Kriticno')),
    ]
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('open', _('Otvoren')), ('in_progress', _('U obradi')),
        ('waiting_client', _('Ceka klijenta')), ('waiting_internal', _('Ceka interni tim')),
        ('resolved', _('Rijesen')), ('closed', _('Zatvoren')),
    ]
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE, null=True, blank=True)
    objects = CompanyManager()
    ticket_number = models.CharField(max_length=20, unique=True)
    subject = models.CharField(max_length=300)
    description = models.TextField()
    category = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=CATEGORY_CHOICES, default='other')
    priority = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=PRIORITY_CHOICES, default='normal')
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='open')
    source = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=[
        ('portal', 'Portal'), ('email', 'Email'), ('phone', 'Telefon'),
        ('whatsapp', 'WhatsApp'), ('internal', 'Interni'),
    ], default='internal')
    client = models.ForeignKey('partners.Partner', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='tickets')
    contact_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default='')
    contact_email = models.CharField(max_length=254, blank=True, default='')
    contact_phone = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default='')
    related_invoice = models.ForeignKey('invoicing.Invoice', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='tickets')
    assigned_to = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='assigned_tickets')
    sla_deadline = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    first_response_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    resolved_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    closed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    satisfaction_rating = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(null=True, blank=True)
    satisfaction_comment = models.TextField(blank=True, default='')
    portal_token = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, unique=True)
    tags = models.CharField(max_length=500, blank=True, default='')
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='tickets_created')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'Tiket'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Tiketi'
        ordering = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"#{self.ticket_number} - {self.subject}"

    def generate_ticket_number(self):
        year = timezone.now().year
        last = Ticket.objects.filter(ticket_number__startswith=f'TK-{year}-').order_by('-ticket_number').first()
        seq = 1
        if last:
            try: seq = int(last.ticket_number.split('-')[-1]) + 1
            except Exception: pass
        return f'TK-{year}-{seq:04d}'

    @property
    def is_overdue(self):
        if self.sla_deadline and self.status not in ('resolved', 'closed'):
            return timezone.now() > self.sla_deadline
        return False

    def set_sla(self):
        hours_map = {'critical': 2, 'urgent': 4, 'high': 8, 'normal': 24, 'low': 72}
        hours = hours_map.get(self.priority, 24)
        self.sla_deadline = timezone.now() + timezone.timedelta(hours=hours)

--- ./payroll/models.py ---
"""
payroll/models.py — Payroll modul

Arhitektura:
  PayrollRun  → jedan obračun za (company, month, year)
  Payslip     → jedan listić po radniku, agregira TimeEntry podatke
  PayrollJournalLink → veza s konto JournalEntry (audit trail)

Integracija:
  - Podatke vuče iz worktime.TimeEntry (već ima regular/overtime/night hours)
  - EmployeeProfile (hourly_rate, overtime_rate, bank_account IBAN)
  - Pain001Generator iz finance.bank_parsers (SALA plaćanja)
  - konto.services.book_payroll() (TEM-PLACA temeljnica)
  - Company.country (HR/DE) određuje porezni engine
"""

from decimal import Decimal
from django.db import models, transaction
from django.conf import settings
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _
from core.managers import CompanyManager


class PayrollRun(models.Model):
    """
    Jedan obračunski ciklus: (company, year, month).
    Nakon finalizacije, nema izmjena (GoBD/audit).
    """
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('DRAFT',     _('Nacrt')),
        ('LOCKED',    _('Zaključan — obračun u toku')),
        ('FINALIZED', _('Finaliziran — isplata odobrena')),
        ('PAID',      _('Isplaćeno — pain.001 generiran')),
    ]

    company   = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                   related_name='payroll_runs')
    year      = models.IntegerField(verbose_name=_('Godina'))
    month     = models.IntegerField(verbose_name=_('Mjesec'))
    status    = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='DRAFT')

    # Ukupni agregirani iznosi (popunjava se pri finalizaciji)
    total_gross  = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total_net    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total_tax    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0)

    # pain.001 export
    pain001_generated_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    pain001_batch_id     = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)

    # Audit
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                    null=True, blank=True, related_name='payroll_runs_created')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    finalized_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    objects = CompanyManager()

    class Meta:
        unique_together = ('company', 'year', 'month')
        ordering = ['-year', '-month']
        verbose_name = _('Obračun plaća')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Obračuni plaća')

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.company.name} — {self.month:02d}/{self.year}"

    @property
    def period_label(self):
        import calendar
        return f"{calendar.month_name[self.month]} {self.year}"

    def lock(self):
        """
        Zaključava obračun za izmjene dok traje izračun.
        Koristi select_for_update() — atomarno.
        """
        with transaction.atomic():
            run = PayrollRun.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=self.pk)
            if run.status not in ('DRAFT',):
                raise ValueError(f"Ne može se zaključati: status je {run.status}")
            run.status = 'LOCKED'
            run.save(update_fields=['status'])
            self.status = 'LOCKED'

    def unlock_to_draft(self):
        """Vraća u DRAFT (samo ako nije FINALIZED/PAID)."""
        if self.status in ('FINALIZED', 'PAID'):
            raise ValueError("Finalizirani obračun ne može se otvoriti.")
        self.status = 'DRAFT'
        self.save(update_fields=['status'])


class Payslip(models.Model):
    """
    Obračunski listić za jednog radnika.

    Satnica (hourly_rate) se kopira u trenutku obračuna —
    naknadna izmjena EmployeeProfile ne smije retroaktivno
    mijenjati stare obračune (GoBD §146 Abs.4).
    """
    payroll_run = models.ForeignKey(PayrollRun, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                     related_name='payslips')
    user        = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
                                     on_delete=models.PROTECT,
                                     related_name='payslips')

    # Sati agregirati iz TimeEntry (APPROVED) za period
    regular_hours  = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    overtime_hours = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    night_hours    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total_hours    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, default=0)

    # Satnice u trenutku obračuna (snapshot — ne mijenja se!)
    hourly_rate_snapshot   = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    overtime_rate_snapshot = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)

    # Iznosi
    gross_amount         = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Bruto'))
    # HR porezni engine
    contributions_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Doprinosi iz'))
    tax_base             = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Porezna osnovica'))
    tax_amount           = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Porez + prirez'))
    net_amount           = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Neto'))

    # Isplata
    employee_iban    = models.CharField(max_length=34, blank=True,
                                         verbose_name=_('IBAN radnika'))
    is_paid          = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    payment_reference = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)

    # DATEV export flag (DE kompanije)
    datev_exported   = models.BooleanField(default=False)

    # ArbZG/ZOR upozorenja iz perioda
    compliance_notes = models.TextField(blank=True)

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        unique_together = ('payroll_run', 'user')
        ordering = ['user__last_name', 'user__first_name']
        verbose_name = _('Obračunski listić')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Obračunski listići')

    def __str__(self):
        return (f"{self.user.get_full_name() or self.user.username} — "
                f"{self.payroll_run}")

    @property
    def employee_name(self):
        return self.user.get_full_name() or self.user.username

"""
Propter models -- Faza A + B

Faza A: BillingPeriod, Otpremnica, OtpremnicaItem
Faza B: PropterTenant, PropterOperator

import uuid
from decimal import Decimal
from django.db import models

class BillingPeriod(models.Model):
    """Obracunski period (mjesec) per firma.
    Skuplja otpremnice kroz cijeli mjesec.
    Na kraju perioda aggregate_to_eracun() kreira jedan zbirni e-Racun.
    """

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        OPEN      = "open",     "Otvoren"
        CLOSING   = "closing",  "Zatvara se"
        CLOSED    = "closed",   "Zatvoren"
        INVOICED  = "invoiced", "Fakturiran"

    company = models.ForeignKey(
        "companies.Company", on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="billing_periods"
    )
    year  = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField()
    month = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField()  # 1-12

    status      = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=Status.choices, default=Status.OPEN)
    opened_at   = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    closed_at   = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    invoiced_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    # Zbirni e-Racun kreiran na kraju perioda (FK na eracun.ERacun)
    zbirni_eracun_id     = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True, db_index=True)
    zbirni_invoice_number = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)

    # Snapshot iznosa pri zatvaranju
    total_net        = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total_tax        = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total_with_tax   = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    otpremnica_count = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)

    class Meta:
        unique_together = ("company", "year", "month")
        ordering = ["-year", "-month"]
        verbose_name = "Obracunski period"
        verbose_name_plural = "Obracunski periodi"

    def __str__(self):
        return "{} {}/{:02d} ({})".format(
            self.company.name, self.year, self.month, self.get_status_display()
        )

    @classmethod
    def get_or_create_current(cls, company):
        now = timezone.now()
        period, _ = cls.objects.get_or_create(
            company=company, year=now.year, month=now.month,
            defaults={"status": cls.Status.OPEN}
        )
        return period


class Otpremnica(models.Model):
    """Otpremnica (delivery note).
    Izvor: POS zatvaranje smjene, rucni unos, Synesis sync, API.
    Agregira se na kraju perioda u jedan zbirni e-Racun.
    """

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        DRAFT      = "draft",      "Nacrt"
        ISSUED     = "issued",     "Izdana"
        AGGREGATED = "aggregated", "Ukljucena u zbirni racun"
        CANCELLED  = "cancelled",  "Stornirana"

    class Source(models.TextChoices):
        POS     = "pos",     "POS blagajna"
        MANUAL  = "manual",  "Rucni unos"
        SYNESIS = "synesis", "Synesis"
        API     = "api",     "API"
        INVOICE = "invoice", "Faktura"

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)

    company = models.ForeignKey(
        "companies.Company", on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="otpremnice"
    )
    billing_period = models.ForeignKey(
        BillingPeriod, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="otpremnice", null=True, blank=True
    )

    # Veze na izvorne dokumente (opcionalno -- loose coupling)
    pos_receipt_id = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True, db_index=True)
    invoice_id     = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True, db_index=True)

    number        = models.CharField(max_length=50, verbose_name="Broj otpremnice")
    issue_date    = models.DateField()
    delivery_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)

    recipient_name    = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    recipient_oib     = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True)
    recipient_address = models.CharField(max_length=300, blank=True)

    subtotal   = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    tax_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total      = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)

    source = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=Source.choices, default=Source.MANUAL)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=12, choices=Status.choices, default=Status.DRAFT)
    note   = models.TextField(blank=True)

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        "auth.User", on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True
    )

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["-issue_date", "-created_at"]
        verbose_name = "Otpremnica"
        verbose_name_plural = "Otpremnice"
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["company", "status"]),
            models.Index(fields=["company", "billing_period"]),
            models.Index(fields=["issue_date"]),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return "OTP-{} -> {} ({} EUR)".format(self.number, self.recipient_name, self.total)

    def save(self, **kwargs):
        if not self.billing_period_id and self.company_id:
            self.billing_period = BillingPeriod.get_or_create_current(self.company)
        if not self.number:
            now = timezone.now()
            count = Otpremnica.objects.filter(
                company=self.company,
                issue_date__year=now.year
            ).count() + 1
            self.number = "{}-{:04d}".format(now.year, count)
        super().save(**kwargs)

class PropterConfig(models.Model):
    """SaaS tenant za Propter modul.

    Tier bookkeeper: vodi N klijenata, max pretplata.
    Tier client: vlastita firma, manja pretplata.

    Arhitektura certifikata (zakonski):
        - Svaki klijent ima vlastiti FINA certifikat
        - KS Limit/operator nije registrirana pristupna tocka
        - Kad zakon dopusti -- operator moze biti pristupna tocka
    """

    class Tier(models.TextChoices):
        CLIENT      = "client",      "Komitent (direktni)"
        BOOKKEEPER  = "bookkeeper",  "Knjigovodstveni servis"
        OPERATOR    = "operator",    "Operator/Hub (buducnost)"

    class CertStatus(models.TextChoices):
        NONE    = "none",    "Nema certifikata"
        PENDING = "pending", "Ceka certifikat"
        ACTIVE  = "active",  "Aktivan"
        EXPIRED = "expired", "Istekao"

    company = models.OneToOneField(
        "companies.Company", on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="propter_config"
    )

    tier            = models.CharField(max_length=15, choices=Tier.choices, default=Tier.CLIENT)
    operator_name   = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True,
                                       help_text="Npr. KS Limit d.o.o.")
    max_clients     = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=1,
                                                  help_text="Za bookkeepere: max klijenata")

    # FINA certifikat status
    cert_status      = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=CertStatus.choices,
                                        default=CertStatus.NONE)
    cert_valid_until = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)

    # Moduli ukljuceni u pretplatu
    modules_enabled = models.JSONField(default=list,
                                       help_text="Slugovi modula: eracun, payroll, pos, ...")

    # Pretplata
    monthly_fee  = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    billing_day  = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(default=1)  # dan u mj. naplate
    is_active    = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    trial_until  = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)

    # Eco/marketing
    eco_badge_enabled = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    public_eco_page   = models.BooleanField(default=False,
                                            help_text="Javna eko stranica za klijenta")

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = "Propter tenant"
        verbose_name_plural = "Propter tenanti"

    def __str__(self):
        return "{} [{}] {}/mj".format(
            self.company.name, self.get_tier_display(), self.monthly_fee
        )

    @property
    def is_trial(self):
        return self.trial_until and self.trial_until >= timezone.now().date()

    @property
    def cert_is_valid(self):
        if self.cert_status != self.CertStatus.ACTIVE:
            return False
        if self.cert_valid_until and self.cert_valid_until < timezone.now().date():
            return False
        return True

class EkoStats(models.Model):
    """Eko statistika po firmi i mjesecu.
    Automatski se izracunava pri zatvaranju BillingPeriod-a.

    Marketing: 'bez papira', CO2 usteda, ESG reporting.
    Badge razine: bronze 50+, silver 200+, gold 500+, platinum 1000+ e-racuna/mj
    """

    class Badge(models.TextChoices):
        NONE     = "",          "Bez bedza"
        BRONZE   = "bronze",   "Bronze (50+)"
        SILVER   = "silver",   "Silver (200+)"
        GOLD     = "gold",     "Gold (500+)"
        PLATINUM = "platinum", "Platinum (1000+)"

    company        = models.ForeignKey(
        "companies.Company", on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="eko_stats"
    )
    billing_period = models.OneToOneField(
        BillingPeriod, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="eko_stats", null=True, blank=True
    )
    year  = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField()
    month = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField()

    # Brojaci
    eracuni_sent     = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    otpremnice_count = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)

    # Eko izracun (IPCC standard: 5g CO2 po listu A4)
    paper_saved_sheets  = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    co2_saved_grams     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    trees_equivalent    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=4, default=0)

    # Kumulativ za godinu
    paper_saved_ytd  = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    co2_saved_ytd    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)

    badge_level = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=Badge.choices, blank=True, default="")

    calculated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        unique_together = ("company", "year", "month")
        ordering = ["-year", "-month"]
        verbose_name = "Eko statistika"
        verbose_name_plural = "Eko statistike"

    def __str__(self):
        return "{} {}/{:02d} -- {}g CO2 usteda [{}]".format(
            self.company.name, self.year, self.month,
            self.co2_saved_grams, self.badge_level or "bez bedza"
        )

    @classmethod
    def calculate(cls, billing_period):
        """Izracunaj i spremi eko statistiku za period."""
        from decimal import Decimal

        count = billing_period.otpremnica_count or 0

        # CO2: 5g po listu, prosjecno 2 lista po dokumentu (original + kopija)
        sheets = count * 2
        co2 = Decimal(str(sheets * 5))  # grama
        # 1 stablo apsorbira ~21700g CO2/god
        trees = co2 / Decimal("21700") if co2 > 0 else Decimal("0")

        # Badge logika
        if count >= 1000:
            badge = cls.Badge.PLATINUM
        elif count >= 500:
            badge = cls.Badge.GOLD
        elif count >= 200:
            badge = cls.Badge.SILVER
        elif count >= 50:
            badge = cls.Badge.BRONZE
        else:
            badge = ""

        # YTD -- zbroj prethodnih mjeseci iste godine
        ytd_qs = cls.objects.filter(
            company=billing_period.company,
            year=billing_period.year,
            month__lt=billing_period.month
        )
        ytd_sheets = sum(e.paper_saved_sheets for e in ytd_qs) + sheets
        ytd_co2 = sum(e.co2_saved_grams for e in ytd_qs) + co2

        eko, _ = cls.objects.update_or_create(
            company=billing_period.company,
            year=billing_period.year,
            month=billing_period.month,
            defaults={
                "billing_period": billing_period,
                "eracuni_sent": count,
                "otpremnice_count": count,
                "paper_saved_sheets": sheets,
                "co2_saved_grams": co2,
                "trees_equivalent": trees.quantize(Decimal("0.0001")),
                "paper_saved_ytd": ytd_sheets,
                "co2_saved_ytd": ytd_co2,
                "badge_level": badge,
            }
        )
        return eko

from django.db import models
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _
from core.managers import CompanyManager
import uuid
import random
import string


class Property(models.Model):
    """A rental property unit (room, apartment, house)."""
    TYPE_CHOICES = [
        ('room', _('Soba')),
        ('apartment', _('Apartman')),
        ('house', _('Kuca')),
        ('suite', _('Suite')),
        ('dorm', _('Dorm / Spavaonica')),
        ('office', _('Ured')),
        ('parking', _('Parking')),
    ]
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('available', _('Slobodna')),
        ('occupied', _('Zauzeta')),
        ('cleaning', _('Ciscenje')),
        ('maintenance', _('Odrzavanje')),
        ('blocked', _('Blokirana')),
    ]

    company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='rental_properties', verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    objects = CompanyManager()

    name = models.CharField(max_length=100, verbose_name=_('Naziv'))
    type = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=TYPE_CHOICES, default='room', verbose_name=_('Tip'))
    floor = models.CharField(max_length=30, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Kat / Zona'))
    description = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Opis'))
    capacity = models.IntegerField(default=2, verbose_name=_('Kapacitet (osoba)'))
    beds = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Kreveti'),
                             help_text=_('npr. 1x bracni, 2x single'))

    # Pricing
    price_per_night = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                           verbose_name=_('Cijena po noci (EUR)'))
    price_weekend = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True,
                                         verbose_name=_('Cijena vikend'))
    price_weekly = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True,
                                        verbose_name=_('Cijena tjedna'))
    price_monthly = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True,
                                         verbose_name=_('Cijena mjesecna'))
    tourist_tax = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=1,
                                       verbose_name=_('Boravisna pristojba po osobi/noci'))
    cleaning_fee = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                        verbose_name=_('Naknada za ciscenje'))
    min_nights = models.IntegerField(default=1, verbose_name=_('Min. noci'))

    # Smart Lock / Access
    smart_lock_id = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Smart Lock ID'))
    smart_lock_type = models.CharField(max_length=30, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Tip brave'),
                                        help_text=_('nuki, ttlock, igloohome, yale'))
    wifi_name = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, verbose_name=_('WiFi naziv'))
    wifi_password = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, verbose_name=_('WiFi lozinka'))

    # QR / Access
    qr_code = models.CharField(max_length=32, unique=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('QR kod'))

    # Status
    status = models.CharField(max_length=15, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='available',
                                verbose_name=_('Status'))
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name=_('Aktivna'))
    location = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Lokacija / Adresa'))
    photo_url = models.URLField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Foto URL'))

    # Amenities
    amenities = models.JSONField(default=list, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Pogodnosti'),
                                  help_text=_('["wifi","parking","ac","tv","kitchen"]'))

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Nekretnina')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Nekretnine')
        ordering = ['floor', 'name']

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.name} ({self.get_type_display()})'

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self.qr_code:
            self.qr_code = uuid.uuid4().hex[:16]
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    @property
    def is_available(self):
        return self.status == 'available' and self.is_active

    guest_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, verbose_name=_('Ime gosta'))
    guest_email = models.EmailField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Email'))
    guest_phone = models.CharField(max_length=30, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Telefon'))
    guest_country = models.CharField(max_length=3, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Drzava'),
                                      help_text=_('ISO 3166 kod (HR, DE, AT...)'))
    guest_id_number = models.CharField(max_length=30, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Broj dokumenta'))
    guest_count = models.IntegerField(default=1, verbose_name=_('Broj gostiju'))

    # Dates
    check_in = models.DateField(verbose_name=_('Check-in'))
    check_out = models.DateField(verbose_name=_('Check-out'))
    actual_check_in = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Stvarni check-in'))
    actual_check_out = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Stvarni check-out'))

    # Pricing
    price_per_night = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Cijena/noc'))
    total_nights = models.IntegerField(default=1, verbose_name=_('Broj noci'))
    subtotal = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Podnos'))
    tourist_tax_total = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                             verbose_name=_('Boravisna pristojba'))
    cleaning_fee = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Ukupno'))

    # Access
    access_code = models.CharField(max_length=8, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Pristupni kod'))
    access_qr = models.CharField(max_length=64, unique=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('QR pristup'))
    access_valid_from = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    access_valid_until = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    # Status
    status = models.CharField(max_length=15, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='pending',
                                verbose_name=_('Status'))
    source = models.CharField(max_length=15, choices=SOURCE_CHOICES, default='direct',
                                verbose_name=_('Izvor'))
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Napomene'))
    is_paid = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Placeno'))

    # Payment link
    payment_id = models.UUIDField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Payment ID'))

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Rezervacija')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Rezervacije')
        ordering = ['-check_in']

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.booking_number} - {self.guest_name} ({self.check_in} to {self.check_out})'

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self.booking_number:
            prefix = self.company.name[:2].upper() if self.company else 'RH'
            num = Booking.objects.filter(company=self.company).count() + 1
            self.booking_number = f'{prefix}-{num:05d}'
        if not self.access_code:
            self.access_code = ''.join(random.choices(string.digits, k=6))
        if not self.access_qr:
            self.access_qr = uuid.uuid4().hex
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def calculate_price(self):
        """Calculate total price including tax and fees."""
        from datetime import timedelta
        nights = (self.check_out - self.check_in).days
        if nights < 1:
            nights = 1
        self.total_nights = nights
        self.subtotal = self.price_per_night * nights
        self.tourist_tax_total = self.rental_property.tourist_tax * self.guest_count * nights
        self.cleaning_fee = self.rental_property.cleaning_fee
        self.total_price = self.subtotal + self.tourist_tax_total + self.cleaning_fee
        return self.total_price

    @property

    def is_active_stay(self):
        from django.utils import timezone
        today = timezone.now().date()
        return self.status == 'checked_in' and self.check_in <= today <= self.check_out

class IncomingMail(models.Model):
    """Pristigla posta — skenirana i pohranjena."""
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('received', 'Zaprimljeno'),
        ('scanned', 'Skenirano'),
        ('forwarded', 'Proslijedjeno'),
        ('archived', 'Arhivirano'),
    ]
    MAIL_TYPE_CHOICES = [
        ('letter', 'Pismo'),
        ('invoice', 'Racun'),
        ('notice', 'Obavijest'),
        ('tax', 'Porezna uprava'),
        ('court', 'Sud / Odvjetnik'),
        ('bank', 'Banka'),
        ('insurance', 'Osiguranje'),
        ('package', 'Paket'),
        ('other', 'Ostalo'),
    ]

    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                 related_name='incoming_mail')
    received_date = models.DateField()
    sender = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True,
        help_text='Posiljatelj (ako je vidljivo na omotnici)')
    mail_type = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=MAIL_TYPE_CHOICES, default='letter')
    subject = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True,
        help_text='Kratak opis sadrzaja')
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='received')

    # Skenirani dokument
    scanned_file = models.FileField(upload_to='virtual_office/scans/%Y/%m/', blank=True)
    scan_pages = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)

    # Tko je obradio
    processed_by = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                      null=True, blank=True, related_name='processed_mail')
    processed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    # Klijent je pregledao?
    client_viewed = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    client_viewed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    notes = models.TextField(blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-received_date', '-created_at']
        verbose_name = 'Pristigla posta'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Pristigla posta'

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.get_mail_type_display()}: {self.sender or "Nepoznat"} ({self.received_date})'

from django.db import models


class SystemAuditLog(models.Model):
    """Immutable audit trail for all financial data changes."""
    ACTION_CHOICES = [
        ('create', 'Kreiranje'),
        ('update', 'Ažuriranje'),
        ('delete', 'Brisanje'),
    ]

    timestamp = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True, db_index=True)
    user = models.ForeignKey('auth.User', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True)
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True)
    action = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=ACTION_CHOICES)
    model_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, db_index=True)
    object_id = models.CharField(max_length=50)
    object_repr = models.CharField(max_length=300, blank=True)
    changes = models.JSONField(default=dict, blank=True)
    ip_address = models.GenericIPAddressField(null=True, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-timestamp']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['model_name', 'object_id']),
            models.Index(fields=['company', 'timestamp']),
            models.Index(fields=['user', 'timestamp']),
        ]
        verbose_name = 'Revizijski zapis'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Revizijski zapisi'

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.timestamp:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} | {self.action} | {self.model_name} | {self.object_repr[:50]}"

import uuid

from django.db import models
from django.utils.text import slugify
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _


class NKDCode(models.Model):
    """
    NKD 2007 (Nacionalna klasifikacija djelatnosti) — HR verzija NACE Rev.2
    Hijerarhija: Odjeljak (A) → Područje (47) → Razred (47.1) → Podrazred (47.11)
    """

    class Level(models.TextChoices):
        SECTION  = 'section',  'Odjeljak (A–U)'
        DIVISION = 'division', 'Područje (XX)'
        GROUP    = 'group',    'Razred (XX.X)'
        CLASS    = 'class',    'Podrazred (XX.XX)'

    code     = models.CharField(max_length=10, unique=True, db_index=True, verbose_name='Šifra NKD',
                                 help_text='Npr. A, 47, 47.1, 47.11')
    level    = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=Level.choices, verbose_name='Razina')
    section  = models.CharField(max_length=2, db_index=True, verbose_name='Odjeljak (A–U)')
    name_hr  = models.CharField(max_length=500, verbose_name='Naziv (HR)')
    name_en  = models.CharField(max_length=500, blank=True, verbose_name='Naziv (EN)')
    parent   = models.ForeignKey('self', null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                  related_name='children', verbose_name='Nadređena kategorija')
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name='Aktivna')
    allow_negative_stock = models.BooleanField(
        default=True,
        verbose_name='Dozvoli negativne zalihe',
        help_text='Ako je uklju\u010deno, prodaja je mogu\u0107a i kad je stanje 0.',
    )

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = 'NKD šifra'
        verbose_name_plural = 'NKD šifarnik'
        ordering            = ['code']

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.code} \u2013 {self.name_hr}'


class Company(models.Model):

    class Country(models.TextChoices):
        HR    = 'HR',    _('Hrvatska')
        DE    = 'DE',    _('Njemačka')
        AT    = 'AT',    _('Austrija')
        SI    = 'SI',    _('Slovenija')
        BA    = 'BA',    _('Bosna i Hercegovina')
        RS    = 'RS',    _('Srbija')
        OTHER = 'OTHER', _('Ostalo')

    class BusinessType(models.TextChoices):
        DOO              = 'doo',              _('d.o.o. (Društvo s ograničenom odgovornošću)')
        JDOO             = 'jdoo',             _('j.d.o.o. (Jednostavno d.o.o.)')
        DD               = 'dd',               _('d.d. (Dioničko društvo)')
        OBRT             = 'obrt',             _('Obrt')
        GMBH             = 'gmbh',             _('GmbH')
        AG               = 'ag',               _('AG (Aktiengesellschaft)')
        EINZELUNTERNEHMEN = 'einzelunternehmen', _('Einzelunternehmen')
        OTHER            = 'other',            _('Ostalo')

    class Currency(models.TextChoices):
        EUR = 'EUR', 'EUR (Euro)'
        USD = 'USD', 'USD (US Dollar)'
        GBP = 'GBP', 'GBP (British Pound)'
        CHF = 'CHF', 'CHF (Swiss Franc)'
        BAM = 'BAM', 'BAM (Bosanska marka)'
        RSD = 'RSD', 'RSD (Srpski dinar)'

    class FiscalSystem(models.TextChoices):
        HR_FISCALIZATION = 'hr_fiscal', _('HR Fiskalizacija (CIS)')
        DE_GOBD          = 'de_gobd',   _('DE GoBD')
        AT_RKSV          = 'at_rksv',   _('AT RKSV')
        NONE             = 'none',      _('Bez fiskalizacije')

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    name     = models.CharField(max_length=200, verbose_name=_('Naziv tvrtke'))
    oib      = models.CharField(max_length=50, unique=True, verbose_name='OIB / Steuernummer')
    address  = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Adresa'))

    PDV_STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('none',             'Nije u sustavu PDV-a'),
        ('obveznik',         'Obveznik PDV-a'),
        ('pausalic',         'Paušalac (HR §90)'),
        ('kleinunternehmer', 'Kleinunternehmer (DE §19 UStG)'),
    ]
    pdv_status = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=PDV_STATUS_CHOICES, default='none',
        verbose_name='PDV status',
    )
    is_kleinunternehmer = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        verbose_name='Kleinunternehmer §19 UStG',
        help_text='DE: oslobođen PDV-a prema §19 UStG ako god.prihodi < 22.000 EUR',
    )

    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    # Geofence / GPS
    latitude = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name='GPS Latitude')
    longitude = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name='GPS Longitude')

        default=200, verbose_name='Geofence radius (m)',
        help_text='Maksimalna udaljenost za clock-in (metara)')

    is_platform_owner = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        verbose_name='Platform Owner',
        help_text='Firma vlasnika platforme – svi moduli otključani bez pretplate',
    )

    # Parent-Child (B2B2B Umbrella)
    umbrella_parent = models.ForeignKey(
        'self', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='umbrella_children',
        verbose_name='Nadredjena tvrtka (Umbrella)',
    )
    UMBRELLA_RELATION_CHOICES = [
        ('subsidiary', 'Podru\u017enica / Sestrinska firma'),
        ('client', 'Klijent (knjigovodstvo)'),
        ('franchise', 'Fran\u0161iza'),
    ]
    is_umbrella = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name='Umbrella tvrtka')
    umbrella_relation = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=UMBRELLA_RELATION_CHOICES,
        default='client', blank=True,
        verbose_name='Tip veze s umbrella',
    )
    umbrella_max_children = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0, verbose_name='Max podtvrtki')
    umbrella_monthly_fee = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='Umbrella mj. naknada (EUR)',
    )

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self.booking_slug and self.name:
            base_slug = slugify(self.name)
            slug = base_slug
            n = 1
            while Company.objects.filter(booking_slug=slug).exclude(pk=self.pk).exists():
                slug = f"{base_slug}-{n}"
                n += 1
            self.booking_slug = slug
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Tvrtka')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Tvrtke')

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.name} ({self.oib})'

class BusinessProfile(models.Model):
    """
    Industrijski profil tvrtke — kontrolira module, cjenik i workflow.

    Primjeri: frizer, mehaničar, građevina, optika, restoran, webshop...
    Vezan 1:1 na Company.
    """
    class ProfileType(models.TextChoices):
        FRIZER        = 'frizer',     _('Frizerski salon')
        MEHANIČAR     = 'mehaničar',  _('Auto mehaničar')
        GRAĐEVINA     = 'gradjevina', _('Građevina / Renovacija')
        OPTIKA        = 'optika',     _('Optika')
        RESTORAN      = 'restoran',   _('Restoran / Caffe bar')
        WEBSHOP       = 'webshop',    _('Online trgovina')
        CONSULTING    = 'consulting', _('Konzalting / IT usluge')
        CUSTOM        = 'custom',     _('Prilagođeno')

    company = models.OneToOneField(
        'Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='business_profile',
        verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    profile_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=ProfileType.choices,
        default=ProfileType.CUSTOM,
        verbose_name=_('Tip profila'),
    )

    # ── Vidljivost modula (nav) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    module_invoicing    = models.BooleanField(default=True,  verbose_name=_('Fakturiranje'))
    module_pos          = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('POS kasa'))
    module_inventory    = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Zalihe'))
    module_appointments = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Termini'))
    module_projects     = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Projekti'))
    module_worktime     = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Radni sati'))
    module_finance      = models.BooleanField(default=True,  verbose_name=_('Financije'))
    module_partners     = models.BooleanField(default=True,  verbose_name=_('Partneri'))
    module_documents    = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Dokumenti'))
    module_webshop      = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Webshop'))
    module_rental       = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Najam'))
    module_fitness      = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Fitness'))

    # ── Workflow tip ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    class WorkflowType(models.TextChoices):
        INVOICE_ONLY  = 'invoice',     _('Samo fakturiranje')
        APPOINTMENT   = 'appointment', _('Termini + fakturiranje')
        WORK_ORDER    = 'work_order',  _('Radni nalozi')
        PROJECT       = 'project',     _('Projektni rad')
        POS           = 'pos',         _('POS kasa (maloprodaja)')

    workflow_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=WorkflowType.choices,
        default=WorkflowType.INVOICE_ONLY,
        verbose_name=_('Tip workflowa'),
    )

    # ── Prilagođeni nazivi dokumenata ─────────────────────────────────────────
    offer_label    = models.CharField(max_length=50, default='Ponuda',    verbose_name=_('Naziv ponude'))
    invoice_label  = models.CharField(max_length=50, default='Račun',     verbose_name=_('Naziv računa'))
    workorder_label = models.CharField(max_length=50, default='Radni nalog', verbose_name=_('Naziv radnog naloga'))

    # ── Prilagođena polja na dokumentima (JSON) ───────────────────────────────
    # Format: [{"name": "gradiliste", "label": "Gradilište", "type": "text", "required": false}]
    custom_invoice_fields = models.JSONField(
        default=list, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('Prilagođena polja na fakturi'),
        help_text=_('JSON lista polja koja se dodaju na formu računa/ponude'),
    )

    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Poslovni profil')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Poslovni profili')

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.company.name} — {self.get_profile_type_display()}'

    @property
    def enabled_modules(self):
        """Vraća listu stringova s nazivima aktivnih modula."""
        return [
            mod for mod in [
                'invoicing', 'pos', 'inventory', 'appointments',
                'projects', 'worktime', 'finance', 'partners',
                'documents', 'webshop', 'rental', 'fitness',
            ]
            if getattr(self, f'module_{mod}', False)
        ]

class CompanyBranch(models.Model):
    """Pod-firma / poslovnica unutar matične tvrtke."""

    BRANCH_TYPES = [
        ('optika',      'Optika'),
        ('fitness',     'Fitness centar'),
        ('retail',      'Trgovina'),
        ('accounting',  'Knjigovodstvo'),
        ('restaurant',  'Restoran'),
        ('salon',       'Salon ljepote'),
        ('other',       'Ostalo'),
    ]

    parent_company = models.ForeignKey(
        'Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='branches', verbose_name='Matična tvrtka',
    )
    name        = models.CharField(max_length=200, verbose_name='Naziv podružnice')
    branch_code = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True, verbose_name='Šifra')
    branch_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=BRANCH_TYPES, default='other',
        verbose_name='Tip poslovnice',
    )
    address     = models.CharField(max_length=300, blank=True, verbose_name='Adresa')
    city        = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name='Grad')
    phone       = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, verbose_name='Telefon')
    email       = models.EmailField(blank=True, verbose_name='E-mail')

    # Module override — empty list = inherit parent company subscription
    active_modules = models.JSONField(
        default=list, blank=True,
        verbose_name='Aktivni moduli (override)',
        help_text='Prazno = nasljeđuje plan matične tvrtke',
    )

    is_active  = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name='Aktivna')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = 'Podružnica'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Podružnice'
        ordering            = ['name']
        unique_together     = [('parent_company', 'branch_code')]

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.name} ({self.get_branch_type_display()})'

    @property
    def allowed_modules(self):
        """Return set of allowed module names. Checks override first, then parent plan."""
        if self.active_modules:
            return set(self.active_modules)
        try:
            sub = self.parent_company.subscriptions.filter(status='active').first()
            if sub:
                return sub.allowed_modules
        except Exception:
            pass
        return set()

    @property
    def dashboard_url(self):
        mapping = {
            'optika':     '/branches/optika/',
            'fitness':    '/branches/fitness/',
            'retail':     '/branches/retail/',
            'accounting': '/branches/accounting/',
            'restaurant': '/branches/restaurant/',
            'salon':      '/branches/salon/',
        }
        return mapping.get(self.branch_type, '/branches/other/')

    @property
    def badge_color(self):
        mapping = {
            'optika':     '#60a5fa',
            'fitness':    '#4ade80',
            'retail':     '#f97316',
            'accounting': '#a78bfa',
            'restaurant': '#fb923c',
            'salon':      '#f472b6',
        }
        return mapping.get(self.branch_type, '#888')



class OnboardingProgress(models.Model):
    company              = models.OneToOneField(Company, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='onboarding')
    profile_completed    = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    first_partner_added  = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    first_invoice_created = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    bank_account_added   = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    first_item_added     = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    first_employee_added = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    pos_configured       = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    ai_intro_completed   = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    ai_intro_shown       = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    dismissed            = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    created_at           = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at           = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = 'Onboarding napredak'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Onboarding napredak'

    def __str__(self):
        return f'Onboarding — {self.company}'

    @property
    def completed_steps(self):
        return sum([
            self.profile_completed,
            self.first_partner_added,
            self.first_invoice_created,
            self.bank_account_added,
            self.first_item_added,
            self.first_employee_added,
            self.ai_intro_completed,
        ])

    @property
    def total_steps(self):
        return 7

    @property
    def percent(self):
        return int(self.completed_steps / self.total_steps * 100)

    tse_tss_id = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, help_text='TSS ID iz fiskaly dashboarda')
    tse_client_id = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'Fiskalna konfiguracija'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Fiskalne konfiguracije'
        unique_together = ['company', 'branch']

    def __str__(self):
        branch_name = self.branch.name if self.branch else 'Svi'
        return f"{self.company} / {branch_name} - {self.get_provider_display()}"

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-created_at']
        verbose_name = 'Fiskalni log'

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.db import models
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _


class ProjectLead(models.Model):

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        NOVI_UPIT          = 'NOVI_UPIT',          _('Novi upit')
        INTERNA_PROCJENA   = 'INTERNA_PROCJENA',   _('Interna procjena')
        NA_BURZI           = 'NA_BURZI',           _('Na burzi')
        PREUZETO           = 'PREUZETO',           _('Preuzeto')
        RIJESENO           = 'RIJESENO',           _('Riješeno')

    class Category(models.TextChoices):
        KUPAONICA  = 'kupaonica',  _('Kupaonica')
        PLOCICE    = 'plocice',    _('Pločice')
        VODOINSTAL = 'vodoinstal', _('Vodoinstalacije')
        ELEKTRIKA  = 'elektrika',  _('Elektrika')
        GRIJANJE   = 'grijanje',   _('Grijanje')
        RENOVACIJA = 'renovacija', _('Renovacija')
        GRADNJA    = 'gradnja',    _('Gradnja')
        FASADA     = 'fasada',     _('Fasada')
        OSTALO     = 'ostalo',     _('Ostalo')

    company       = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                       related_name='project_leads', null=True, blank=True)
    title         = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    description   = models.TextField()
    category      = models.CharField(max_length=30, choices=Category.choices, default=Category.OSTALO)
    location      = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    budget_from   = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True)
    budget_to     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True)
    desired_start = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    contact_name  = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    contact_phone = models.CharField(max_length=30)
    contact_email = models.EmailField(blank=True)
    status        = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=Status.choices,
                                      default=Status.NOVI_UPIT, db_index=True)
    assigned_to   = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
                                       related_name='assigned_leads')
    internal_notes= models.TextField(blank=True)
    is_public     = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    taken_by      = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                       null=True, blank=True, related_name='taken_leads')
    taken_by_user = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
                                       related_name='taken_leads')
    taken_at      = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_by    = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
                                       related_name='created_leads')
    created_at    = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at    = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = 'Projektni upit'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Projektni upiti'
        ordering            = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.title} – {self.get_status_display()}'

    @property
    def budget_display(self):
        def _fmt(val):
            return f'{val:,.0f}'.replace(',', '.')
        if self.budget_from and self.budget_to:
            return f'€{_fmt(self.budget_from)} – €{_fmt(self.budget_to)}'
        elif self.budget_from:
            return f'od €{_fmt(self.budget_from)}'
        return '–'

from django.db import models
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _
from django.utils import timezone
from core.managers import CompanyManager

class Asset(models.Model):
    CATEGORY_CHOICES = [
        ('vehicle', _('Vozilo')), ('equipment', _('Oprema')), ('it', _('IT oprema')),
        ('pos_device', _('POS uredjaj')), ('cold_chain', _('Hladnjaca/Termobox')),
        ('furniture', _('Namjestaj')), ('tool', _('Alat')), ('other', _('Ostalo')),
    ]
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('active', _('Aktivno')), ('maintenance', _('Na servisu')),
        ('retired', _('Otpisano')), ('sold', _('Prodano')),
    ]
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE, null=True, blank=True)
    objects = CompanyManager()
    name = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    asset_code = models.CharField(max_length=50, unique=True)
    category = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=CATEGORY_CHOICES, default='equipment')
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='active')
    make = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default='')
    model_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default='')
    serial_number = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default='')
    description = models.TextField(blank=True, default='')
    location = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default='')
    photo = models.ImageField(upload_to='assets/', null=True, blank=True)
    registration_plate = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True, default='')
    vin = models.CharField(max_length=17, blank=True, default='')
    mileage = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    fuel_type = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True, default='')
    purchase_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    purchase_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    current_value = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    depreciation_rate = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    warranty_until = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    insurance_until = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    insurance_policy = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default='')
    registration_until = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    leasing_until = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    assigned_to = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='assigned_assets')
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='assets_created')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    depreciation_method = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=[('linear', 'Linearna'), ('declining', 'Degresivna')], default='linear')
    useful_life_months = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=60)
    salvage_value = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    last_depreciation_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    accumulated_depreciation = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'Imovina'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Imovina'
        ordering = ['name']
    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.asset_code} - {self.name}"

    def generate_asset_code(self):
        prefix = self.category[:3].upper() if self.category else 'AST'
        last = Asset.objects.filter(asset_code__startswith=prefix).order_by('-asset_code').first()
        seq = 1
        if last:
            try: seq = int(last.asset_code.split('-')[-1]) + 1
            except Exception: pass
        return f'{prefix}-{seq:04d}'


class MaintenanceSchedule(models.Model):
    FREQUENCY_CHOICES = [
        ('weekly', _('Tjedno')), ('monthly', _('Mjesecno')),
        ('quarterly', _('Kvartalno')), ('semi_annual', _('Polugodisnje')),
        ('annual', _('Godisnje')), ('mileage', _('Po kilometrazi')),
        ('once', _('Jednokratno')),
    ]
    asset = models.ForeignKey(Asset, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='schedules')
    task_name = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True, default='')
    frequency = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=FREQUENCY_CHOICES, default='monthly')
    next_due = models.DateField()
    mileage_interval = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    estimated_cost = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    service_provider = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default='')
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    notify_days_before = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=7)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['next_due']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.task_name} -> {self.asset.name}"

    @property
    def is_overdue(self):
        return self.next_due < timezone.now().date()

    def advance_schedule(self):
        from datetime import timedelta
        freq_map = {
            'weekly': timedelta(weeks=1), 'monthly': timedelta(days=30),
            'quarterly': timedelta(days=91), 'semi_annual': timedelta(days=182),
            'annual': timedelta(days=365),
        }
        delta = freq_map.get(self.frequency)
        if delta:
            self.next_due = timezone.now().date() + delta
            self.save(update_fields=['next_due'])


class MaintenanceLog(models.Model):
    TYPE_CHOICES = [
        ('preventive', _('Preventivno')), ('corrective', _('Korektivno')),
        ('inspection', _('Inspekcija')), ('calibration', _('Kalibracija')),
        ('repair', _('Popravak')),
    ]
    asset = models.ForeignKey(Asset, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='logs')
    schedule = models.ForeignKey(MaintenanceSchedule, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True)
    maintenance_type = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=TYPE_CHOICES, default='preventive')
    title = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True, default='')
    date_performed = models.DateField(default=timezone.now)
    labor_cost = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    parts_cost = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total_cost = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    mileage_at_service = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    service_provider = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default='')
    invoice_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default='')
    performed_by = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='maintenance_performed')
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='maintenance_logged')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-date_performed']

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.total_cost = self.labor_cost + self.parts_cost
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)
        if self.mileage_at_service and self.mileage_at_service > self.asset.mileage:
            self.asset.mileage = self.mileage_at_service
            self.asset.save(update_fields=['mileage'])
        if self.schedule:
            self.schedule.advance_schedule()


class DepreciationLog(models.Model):
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='depreciation_logs')
    asset = models.ForeignKey(Asset, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='depreciation_logs')
    year = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField()
    month = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField()
    amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2)
    journal_entry_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        unique_together = [['asset', 'year', 'month']]
        ordering = ['-year', '-month']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.asset.asset_code} {self.year}-{self.month:02d} {self.amount}"
