class ImpersonationLog(models.Model):
    """Audit trail for every superadmin impersonation session."""
    superadmin  = models.ForeignKey(
        User, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='impersonation_sessions',
        verbose_name='Superadmin'
    )
    company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='impersonation_logs', verbose_name='Tvrtka'
    )
    started_at    = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True, verbose_name='Početak')
    ended_at      = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name='Kraj')
    ip_address    = models.GenericIPAddressField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name='IP adresa')
    actions_count = models.IntegerField(default=0, verbose_name='Broj akcija')

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-started_at']
        verbose_name = 'Log impersonacije'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Logovi impersonacija'

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.superadmin.username} → {self.company.name} @ {self.started_at:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M}"

    @property
    def duration_display(self):
        from django.utils import timezone
        end = self.ended_at or timezone.now()
        secs = int((end - self.started_at).total_seconds())
        h, m, s = secs // 3600, (secs % 3600) // 60, secs % 60
        return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:{s:02d}"

from decimal import Decimal
from django.conf import settings
from django.db import models
from django.core.validators import MinValueValidator
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. KONTNI PLAN (Chart of Accounts)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
class AccountType(models.TextChoices):
    ASSET = 'asset', _('Imovina')           # Klasa 0-3
    LIABILITY = 'liability', _('Obveze')     # Klasa 4
    EQUITY = 'equity', _('Kapital')          # Klasa 9
    INCOME = 'income', _('Prihodi')          # Klasa 7
    EXPENSE = 'expense', _('Rashodi')        # Klasa 4-6


class KontoAccount(models.Model):
    """Konto iz kontnog plana (npr. 1000 - Žiro račun, 1200 - Potraživanja od kupaca)"""
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                related_name='konto_accounts')
    code = models.CharField(max_length=10, verbose_name=_('Šifra konta'),
        help_text='npr. 1000, 1200, 2200, 4000, 7000')
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200, verbose_name=_('Naziv konta'))
    account_type = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=AccountType.choices,
                                     verbose_name=_('Vrsta konta'))
    parent = models.ForeignKey('self', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
                               related_name='children', verbose_name=_('Nadređeni konto'))
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['code']
        unique_together = ['company', 'code']
        verbose_name = _('Konto')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Kontni plan')

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.code} - {self.name}"

    @property
    def balance(self):
        """Trenutni saldo konta"""
        from django.db.models import Sum
        debits = self.ledgerline_entries.filter(side='debit').aggregate(
            t=Sum('amount'))['t'] or Decimal('0')
        credits = self.ledgerline_entries.filter(side='credit').aggregate(
            t=Sum('amount'))['t'] or Decimal('0')
        # Asset i Expense rastu s dugovne strane
        if self.account_type in ('asset', 'expense'):
            return debits - credits
        # Liability, Equity, Income rastu s potražne strane
        return credits - debits


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. ŽIRO RAČUNI (Bank Accounts)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
class BankAccount(models.Model):
    """Žiro račun firme u banci"""
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                related_name='bank_accounts')
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200, verbose_name=_('Naziv'),
        help_text='npr. Glavno Poslovanje - PBZ')
    iban = models.CharField(max_length=34, verbose_name='IBAN')
    bank_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, verbose_name=_('Banka'))
    swift = models.CharField(max_length=11, blank=True, verbose_name='SWIFT/BIC')
    currency = models.CharField(max_length=3, default='EUR', verbose_name=_('Valuta'))

    # Veza na kontni plan
    konto_account = models.ForeignKey(KontoAccount, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Konto'),
        help_text='npr. 1000 - Žiro račun u banci')

    opening_balance = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('Početni saldo'))
    current_balance = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('Trenutni saldo'))
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    is_primary = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Primarni račun'))

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-is_primary', 'name']
        verbose_name = _('Žiro račun')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Žiro računi')

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.name} ({self.iban[-8:]})"

    def recalculate_balance(self):
        """Preračunaj saldo iz svih transakcija"""
        from django.db.models import Sum
        inflows = self.transactions.filter(
            transaction_type='inflow'
        ).aggregate(t=Sum('amount'))['t'] or Decimal('0')
        outflows = self.transactions.filter(
            transaction_type='outflow'
        ).aggregate(t=Sum('amount'))['t'] or Decimal('0')
        self.current_balance = self.opening_balance + inflows - outflows
        self.save(update_fields=['current_balance', 'updated_at'])

class BankTransaction(models.Model):
    """Jedna stavka bankovnog izvoda"""

    TRANSACTION_TYPES = [
        ('inflow', _('Uplata (priljev)')),
        ('outflow', _('Isplata (odljev)')),
    ]

    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('unmatched', _('Nepariran')),
        ('matched', _('Pariran')),
        ('ignored', _('Ignoriran')),
    ]

    bank_account = models.ForeignKey(BankAccount, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                     null=True, blank=True, related_name='transactions')
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE)

    # Podaci iz izvoda
    transaction_date = models.DateField(verbose_name=_('Datum transakcije'))
    value_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Datum valute'))
    amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Iznos'))
    transaction_type = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=TRANSACTION_TYPES)

    # Detalji
    counterparty_name = models.CharField(max_length=300, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('Platitelj/Primatelj'))
    counterparty_iban = models.CharField(max_length=34, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('IBAN platitelja/primatelja'))
    description = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Opis plaćanja'))
    reference_number = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('Poziv na broj'))

    # Pariranje
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='unmatched')
    matched_invoice = models.ForeignKey('invoicing.Invoice', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='bank_transactions',
        verbose_name=_('Pariran račun'))

    # Knjiženje
    is_booked = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Proknjiženo'))

    # Import metadata
    import_batch = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True,
        help_text='ID importa za grupiranje')
    external_id = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True,
        help_text='ID iz banke za dedup')

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-transaction_date', '-id']
        verbose_name = _('Bankovna transakcija')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Bankovne transakcije')
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['company', '-transaction_date']),
            models.Index(fields=['status', 'company']),
            models.Index(fields=['reference_number']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        sign = '+' if self.transaction_type == 'inflow' else '-'
        return f"{self.transaction_date} {sign}{self.amount}\u20ac {self.counterparty_name[:30]}"


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. KNJIŽENJE (Ledger Entries) - Dvostavno
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
class JournalEntry(models.Model):
    """Temeljnica - grupa knjiženja koja mora biti u balansu (duguje = potražuje)"""
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                related_name='journal_entries')
    entry_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, verbose_name=_('Broj temeljnice'))
    date = models.DateField(verbose_name=_('Datum knjiženja'))
    description = models.CharField(max_length=300, verbose_name=_('Opis'))

    # Izvor knjiženja
    SOURCE_TYPES = [
        ('invoice', _('Račun')),
        ('bank_statement', _('Bankovni izvod')),
        ('manual', _('Ručno knjiženje')),
        ('payroll', _('Obračun plaća')),
        ('pos', _('POS promet')),
        ('correction', _('Ispravak')),
        ('depreciation', _('Amortizacija')),
    ]
    source_type = models.CharField(max_length=30, blank=True, choices=SOURCE_TYPES)
    source_invoice = models.ForeignKey('invoicing.Invoice', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='journal_entries')
    source_transaction = models.ForeignKey(BankTransaction, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='journal_entries')

    is_posted = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Proknjiženo'))
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                    null=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-date', '-id']
        verbose_name = _('Temeljnica')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Temeljnice')
        unique_together = [['company', 'entry_number']]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.entry_number} - {self.description}"

    def clean(self):
        from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
        # Period lock check
        if self.date and self.company_id:
            if AccountingPeriod.is_period_locked(self.company, self.date.year, self.date.month):
                if not self.pk or JournalEntry.objects.filter(pk=self.pk, date=self.date).exists() is False:
                    raise ValidationError(
                        f"Razdoblje {self.date.month:02d}/{self.date.year} je zaključano. Knjiženje nije moguće."
                    )
        # Skip balance check for new entries (no lines yet)
        if self.pk and self.lines.exists():
            from django.db.models import Sum
            debits = self.lines.filter(side="debit").aggregate(t=Sum("amount"))["t"] or Decimal("0")
            credits = self.lines.filter(side="credit").aggregate(t=Sum("amount"))["t"] or Decimal("0")
            if debits != credits:
                raise ValidationError(
                    f"Temeljnica nije uravnotežena: duguje={debits}, potražuje={credits}, razlika={abs(debits - credits)}"
                )

    @property
    def is_balanced(self):
        """Provjera: duguje == potražuje"""
        from django.db.models import Sum
        debits = self.lines.filter(side='debit').aggregate(t=Sum('amount'))['t'] or Decimal('0')
        credits = self.lines.filter(side='credit').aggregate(t=Sum('amount'))['t'] or Decimal('0')
        return debits == credits

    @property
    def total_debit(self):
        from django.db.models import Sum
        return self.lines.filter(side='debit').aggregate(t=Sum('amount'))['t'] or Decimal('0')

    @property
    def total_credit(self):
        from django.db.models import Sum
        return self.lines.filter(side='credit').aggregate(t=Sum('amount'))['t'] or Decimal('0')


class LedgerLine(models.Model):
    """Jedan red knjiženja - dugovna ili potražna strana"""
    journal_entry = models.ForeignKey(JournalEntry, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                      related_name='lines')
    account = models.ForeignKey(KontoAccount, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
                                related_name='ledgerline_entries')
    side = models.CharField(max_length=6, choices=[
        ('debit', _('Duguje')),
        ('credit', _('Potražuje')),
    ])
    amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, validators=[MinValueValidator(Decimal('0.01'))])
    integrity_hash = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True, default='',
        verbose_name=_('Integrity Hash'), help_text='SHA-256 chain za GoBD audit')
    description = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Stavka knjiženja')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Stavke knjiženja')

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.account.code} {'D' if self.side == 'debit' else 'P'} {self.amount}"

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        import hashlib
        if not self.integrity_hash:
            data = f"{self.journal_entry_id}|{self.account_id}|{self.side}|{self.amount}"
            self.integrity_hash = hashlib.sha256(data.encode()).hexdigest()
        self.full_clean()
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

class TaxPeriod(models.Model):
    PERIOD_TYPES = [
        ('monthly', _('Miesięczny / Monatlich')),
        ('quarterly', _('Kvartalni / Quartal')),
        ('yearly', _('Godišnji / Jährlich')),
    ]

    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                related_name='tax_periods')
    period_type = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=PERIOD_TYPES, default='monthly')
    year = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField()
    month = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(null=True, blank=True)   # 1-12
    quarter = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(null=True, blank=True) # 1-4

    # Output VAT (izlazni PDV / Umsatzsteuer)
    total_output_vat = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('Izlazni PDV'))
    # Input VAT (pretporez / Vorsteuer)
    total_input_vat = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('Pretporez'))
    # Payable = output - input
    vat_payable = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('PDV za uplatu'))
    # Revenue and expenses in period
    total_revenue = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('Prihodi'))
    total_expenses = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('Rashodi'))

    filing_deadline = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('Rok prijave'))
    is_filed = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Prijavljeno'))
    filed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True)

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-year', '-month', '-quarter']
        unique_together = ['company', 'period_type', 'year', 'month', 'quarter']
        verbose_name = _('Porezno razdoblje')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Porezna razdoblja')

    def __str__(self):
        if self.period_type == 'monthly' and self.month:
            return f"{self.year}-{self.month:02d} ({self.company})"
        if self.period_type == 'quarterly' and self.quarter:
            return f"{self.year} Q{self.quarter} ({self.company})"
        return f"{self.year} ({self.company})"

    @property
    def period_label(self):
        if self.period_type == 'monthly' and self.month:
            import calendar
            return f"{calendar.month_name[self.month]} {self.year}"
        if self.period_type == 'quarterly' and self.quarter:
            return f"Q{self.quarter}/{self.year}"
        return str(self.year)


class TaxLineDetail(models.Model):
    """Per-rate VAT breakdown within a TaxPeriod."""
    period = models.ForeignKey(TaxPeriod, on_delete=models.CASCADE,

    tax_rate = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2,

    revenue_base = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('Porezna osnovica'))
    output_vat = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('Izlazni PDV'))

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-tax_rate']
        unique_together = ['period', 'tax_rate']
        verbose_name = _('Stavka PDV-a')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Stavke PDV-a')

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.period} @ {self.tax_rate}%"


class AccountingPeriod(models.Model):
    """Accounting period lock - prevents posting to closed periods."""
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    year = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    month = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField()
    is_locked = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    locked_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    locked_by = models.ForeignKey(
        'auth.User', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='locked_periods')
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        unique_together = [['company', 'year', 'month']]
        ordering = ['-year', '-month']
        verbose_name = 'Obračunsko razdoblje'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Obračunska razdoblja'

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.month:02d}/{self.year} ({'zaključano' if self.is_locked else 'otvoreno'})"

    def lock(self, user=None):
        from django.utils import timezone
        self.is_locked = True
        self.locked_at = timezone.now()
        self.locked_by = user
        self.save(update_fields=['is_locked', 'locked_at', 'locked_by'])

    def unlock(self, user=None):
        self.is_locked = False
        self.locked_at = None
        self.locked_by = None
        self.save(update_fields=['is_locked', 'locked_at', 'locked_by'])

    @classmethod
    def is_period_locked(cls, company, year, month):
        try:
            period = cls.objects.get(company=company, year=year, month=month)
            return period.is_locked
        except cls.DoesNotExist:
            return False

"""
🔐 RBAC Permission System
Granular role-based access control
"""
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.core.cache import cache
from django.db import models
from django.db.models.signals import post_delete, post_save
from django.dispatch import receiver


class Permission(models.Model):
    """Granular permissions across all modules"""

    MODULE_CHOICES = [
        ('users', '👥 Users'),
        ('companies', '🏢 Companies'),
        ('partners', '🤝 Partners'),
        ('invoices', '📄 Invoices'),
        ('documents', '📎 Documents'),
        ('finance', '💰 Finance'),
        ('worktime', '⏱️ Work Time'),
        ('projects', '📊 Projects'),
        ('reports', '📈 Reports'),
        ('calculator', '🧮 Calculator'),
        ('system', '⚙️ System'),
    ]

    ACTION_CHOICES = [
        ('view', '👁️ View'),
        ('create', '➕ Create'),
        ('edit', '✏️ Edit'),
        ('delete', '🗑️ Delete'),
        ('approve', '✅ Approve'),
        ('export', '📤 Export'),
        ('import', '📥 Import'),
        ('manage', '⚙️ Manage'),
    ]

    module = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=MODULE_CHOICES, db_index=True)
    action = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=ACTION_CHOICES, db_index=True)
    codename = models.CharField(max_length=100, unique=True, db_index=True)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)

    # Hierarchical permissions
    requires = models.ManyToManyField('self', blank=True, symmetrical=False,
                                     related_name='unlocks',
                                     help_text="Required permissions")

    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'permissions'
        ordering = ['module', 'action']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['module', 'action']),
            models.Index(fields=['codename']),
        ]
        unique_together = [['module', 'action']]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.get_module_display()}: {self.get_action_display()}"

    def get_full_codename(self):
        """Return module.action format"""
        return f"{self.module}.{self.action}"
class Role(models.Model):
    """User roles with permission sets"""

    ROLE_TYPES = [
        ('superadmin', '👑 Super Admin'),
        ('company_admin', '🏢 Company Admin'),
        ('accountant', '💼 Accountant'),
        ('manager', '📊 Manager'),
        ('worker', '👷 Worker'),
        ('partner', '🤝 Partner'),
        ('investor', '💰 Investor'),
        ('guest', '👁️ Guest'),
    ]

    role_type = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=ROLE_TYPES, unique=True)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    permissions = models.ManyToManyField(Permission, related_name='roles', blank=True)

    # Role hierarchy
    parent_role = models.ForeignKey('self', null=True, blank=True,
                                   on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                   related_name='child_roles')

    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'roles'
        ordering = ['role_type']

    def __str__(self):
        return self.get_role_type_display()

    def get_all_permissions(self):
        """Get permissions including inherited from parent"""
        perms = set(self.permissions.filter(is_active=True).values_list('codename', flat=True))

        # Inherit from parent
        if self.parent_role:
            perms.update(self.parent_role.get_all_permissions())

        return list(perms)

    def clear_cache(self):
        """Clear cached permissions for this role"""
        cache_key = f"role_perms_{self.role_type}"
        cache.delete(cache_key)
class UserRole(models.Model):
    """User-Role assignment with scope"""

    user = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='user_roles')
    role = models.ForeignKey(Role, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='user_assignments')

    # Scope limitations
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', null=True, blank=True,
                               on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                               help_text="Limit role to specific company")

    # Time-based access
    valid_from = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    valid_until = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    is_primary = models.BooleanField(default=True,
                                     help_text="Primary role for user")

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(User, null=True, blank=True,
                                  on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                  related_name='assigned_roles')

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'user_roles'
        ordering = ['-is_primary', 'role']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['user', 'role']),
            models.Index(fields=['company']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.user.username} - {self.role.name}"

    def is_valid(self):
        """Check if role assignment is currently valid"""
        from django.utils import timezone
        now = timezone.now()

        if self.valid_from and now < self.valid_from:
            return False
        if self.valid_until and now > self.valid_until:
            return False

        return True
class PermissionOverride(models.Model):
    """Override specific permissions for users"""

    user = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='permission_overrides')
    permission = models.ForeignKey(Permission, on_delete=models.CASCADE)

    # Grant or revoke
    grant = models.BooleanField(default=True, help_text="True=Grant, False=Revoke")

    # Scope
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', null=True, blank=True,
                               on_delete=models.CASCADE)

    reason = models.TextField(help_text="Why this override exists")

    valid_until = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True,
                                  related_name='granted_overrides')

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'permission_overrides'
        ordering = ['-created_at']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['user', 'permission']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        action = "GRANT" if self.grant else "REVOKE"
        return f"{action}: {self.user.username} - {self.permission.codename}"
# ============================================================================
# SIGNALS - Clear cache on changes
# ============================================================================
@receiver([post_save, post_delete], sender=Role)
def clear_role_cache(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    """Clear role cache when permissions change"""
    instance.clear_cache()
@receiver([post_save, post_delete], sender=UserRole)
def clear_user_permission_cache(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    """Clear user permission cache"""
    cache_key = f"user_perms_{instance.user.id}"
    cache.delete(cache_key)

from django.db import models
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _

from projects.models import Project


class Normative(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=255, verbose_name=_('Naziv normativa'))
    unit = models.CharField(max_length=20, default='m2', verbose_name=_('Jedinica mjere'))
    base_material_cost = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Cijena materijala'))
    estimated_hours_per_unit = models.FloatField(default=0, verbose_name=_('Sati rada po jedinici'))

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Normativ')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Normativi')

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name

class Calculation(models.Model):
    project = models.OneToOneField(Project, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='calculation')
    margin_percentage = models.FloatField(default=20.0, verbose_name=_('Marža (%)'))
    vat_percentage = models.FloatField(default=25.0, verbose_name=_('PDV (%)'))
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    def calculate_totals(self):
        items = self.items.all()
        total_mat = sum(float(item.unit_price_material) * item.quantity for item in items)
        total_lab = sum(item.labor_hours_per_unit * float(item.labor_rate_applied) * item.quantity for item in items)
        net_total = total_mat + total_lab
        gross_total = net_total * (1 + (self.margin_percentage / 100))
        return {
            'material': round(total_mat, 2),
            'labor': round(total_lab, 2),
            'net_cost': round(net_total, 2),
            'offer_total_net': round(gross_total, 2),
            'offer_total_vat': round(gross_total * (1 + (self.vat_percentage / 100)), 2)
        }

class CalculationItem(models.Model):
    calculation = models.ForeignKey(Calculation, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='items')
    normative = models.ForeignKey(Normative, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True)
    description = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    quantity = models.FloatField(default=1.0)
    unit_price_material = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    labor_hours_per_unit = models.FloatField(default=0)
    labor_rate_applied = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)


# ─── BOM / Bill of Materials ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

class BOM(models.Model):
    """Sastavnica materijala (normativ za InventoryItem)."""
    from django.contrib.auth.models import User as _User
    company         = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    article         = models.ForeignKey(
        'inventory.InventoryItem', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='bom_set', verbose_name=_('Artikl (gotov proizvod)'),
    )
    name            = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Naziv BOM-a'))
    yield_quantity  = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=10, decimal_places=3, default=1,
        verbose_name=_('Prinos (kom gotovog proizvoda)'),
    )
    is_active       = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name=_('Aktivan'))
    notes           = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Napomene'))
    created_at      = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Sastavnica (BOM)')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Sastavnice (BOM)')
        ordering            = ['article__name']

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name or f'BOM — {self.article.name}'

    def total_material_cost(self):
        """Sum of (material.purchase_price * quantity) for all items."""
        from decimal import Decimal
        total = Decimal('0')
        for item in self.items.select_related('material').all():
            price = item.material.purchase_price if item.material else Decimal('0')
            waste_factor = Decimal('1') + item.waste_percent / Decimal('100')
            total += price * item.quantity * waste_factor
        return total.quantize(Decimal('0.01'))


class BOMItem(models.Model):
    """Jedna komponenta sastavnice."""
    bom             = models.ForeignKey(
        BOM, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='items', verbose_name=_('Sastavnica'),
    )
    material        = models.ForeignKey(
        'inventory.InventoryItem', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='used_in_boms', verbose_name=_('Materijal/Komponenta'),
    )
    quantity        = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=10, decimal_places=4, default=1,
        verbose_name=_('Količina'),
    )
    unit            = models.CharField(max_length=20, default='kom', verbose_name=_('JMJ'))
    waste_percent   = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('Otpad (%)'),
    )

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Stavka BOM-a')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Stavke BOM-a')
        ordering            = ['id']

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.material.name} × {self.quantity} {self.unit}'

    @property
    def net_quantity(self):
        """Quantity including waste."""
        from decimal import Decimal
        return self.quantity * (Decimal('1') + self.waste_percent / Decimal('100'))

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.db import models
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _

from core.managers import CompanyManager


class InventoryItem(models.Model):
    CATEGORY_CHOICES = [
        ('material',   _('Materijal')),
        ('tool',       _('Alat')),
        ('equipment',  _('Oprema')),
        ('consumable', _('Potrošni materijal')),
        ('product',    _('Gotov proizvod')),
        ('service',    _('Usluga')),
        ('food',       _('Hrana')),
        ('drink',      _('Piće')),
        ('dessert',    _('Desert')),
        ('special',    _('Posebna ponuda')),
        ('other',      _('Ostalo')),
    ]

    # Multitenancy
    company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='inventory_items',
        verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    objects = CompanyManager()

    name     = models.CharField(max_length=200, verbose_name=_('Naziv'))
    sku      = models.CharField(max_length=50, verbose_name=_('SKU / Šifra'))
    barcode  = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Barkod / EAN'))
    category = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=CATEGORY_CHOICES, default='other', verbose_name=_('Kategorija'))
    description = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Opis'))
    unit     = models.CharField(max_length=20, default='kom', verbose_name=_('Jedinica mjere'))

    # Količine
    quantity     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Trenutna zaliha'))
    min_quantity = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Minimalna zaliha'))
    max_quantity = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Maksimalna zaliha'))

    # Cijene
    purchase_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Nabavna cijena'))
    unit_price     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Prodajna cijena'))

    # PDV
    tax_rate = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.TaxRate', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('PDV stopa'),
    )


    # ── DSFinV-K / KassenSichV flags ─────────────────────────────────────
    is_pfand = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        verbose_name=_("Pfand (povratna ambalaza)"),
        help_text=_("Kaucija za casu/bocu — DSFinV-K GV_TYP=Umsatz, SKR03=8404"),
    )
    linked_pfand_item = models.ForeignKey(
        "self",
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name="parent_articles",
        verbose_name=_("Vezani Pfand artikl"),
        help_text=_("Ako je postavljeno, pri prodaji ovog artikla automatski se dodaje Pfand stavka."),
    )
    pfand_tax_override = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=19,
        verbose_name=_("PDV stopa Pfanda (%)"),
        help_text=_("Obično 19% za Leergut u DE. Ostavite 19 ako niste sigurni."),
    )
    is_tip = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        verbose_name=_("Napojnica radnika (TrinkgeldAN)"),
        help_text=_("Napojnica za radnika — DSFinV-K GV_TYP=TrinkgeldAN, UST=0pct"),
    )
    is_tip_employer = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        verbose_name=_("Napojnica vlasnika (TrinkgeldAG)"),
        help_text=_("Napojnica za vlasnika — DSFinV-K GV_TYP=TrinkgeldAG, UST=19pct"),
    )
    kalo_percent = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_("Kalo %"),
        help_text="Prirodni kalo (npr. 2.5%)",
    )
    is_weighable = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        verbose_name=_("Prodaje se na vagu"),
        help_text="Ako je označeno, POS traži unos težine (kg) pri svakom dodavanju",
    )
    dsfinvk_gv_typ = models.CharField(
        max_length=30, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_("DSFinV-K GV_TYP override"),
        help_text=_("Prazno = automatski Umsatz. Samo za posebne slucajeve."),
    )

    location = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Lokacija u skladištu'))
    supplier = models.ForeignKey(
        'partners.Partner', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('Dobavljač'),
    )
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name=_('Aktivan'))

    # Slika artikla
    image = models.ImageField(
        upload_to='inventory/', blank=True, null=True,
        verbose_name=_('Slika'),
    )
    # Webshop integracija
    webshop_visible = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        verbose_name=_('Vidljiv u webshopu'),
    )

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Artikl')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Artikli')
        ordering = ['name']
        # Unique SKU per company
        unique_together = [('company', 'sku')]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.name} ({self.sku}) – {self.quantity} {self.unit}"


    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)
        if self.webshop_visible:
            try:
                from inventory.sync import sync_to_webshop
                sync_to_webshop(self)
            except Exception:
                pass
    @property
    def is_low_stock(self):
        return self.quantity <= self.min_quantity

    @property
    def margin_percent(self):
        if self.purchase_price and self.purchase_price > 0:
            return round((self.unit_price - self.purchase_price) / self.purchase_price * 100, 2)
        return None

    @property
    def stock_value(self):
        return round(self.quantity * self.purchase_price, 2)

    @property
    def selling_value(self):
        return round(self.quantity * self.unit_price, 2)


class StockMovement(models.Model):
    TYPE_CHOICES = [
        ('in',          _('Ulaz (nabava)')),
        ('out',         _('Izlaz (prodaja/upotreba)')),
        ('adjustment',  _('Korekcija zalihe')),
        ('transfer',    _('Prijenos na drugu lokaciju')),
        ('return',      _('Povrat dobavljaču')),
    ]

    item          = models.ForeignKey(InventoryItem, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                       related_name='movements', verbose_name=_('Artikl'))
    movement_type = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=TYPE_CHOICES, verbose_name=_('Vrsta kretanja'))
    quantity      = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Količina'))
    unit_price    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                         verbose_name=_('Cijena po jedinici (u trenutku kretanja)'))

    # Veza na račun (automatski izlaz zalihe pri fakturiranju)
    invoice       = models.ForeignKey(
        'invoicing.Invoice', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='stock_movements',
        verbose_name=_('Vezani račun'),
    )

    reason        = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Razlog / Napomena'))
    performed_by  = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                       null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Izvršio'))
    created_at    = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Kretanje zalihe')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Kretanja zalihe')
        ordering = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.item.name} {self.get_movement_type_display()} {self.quantity}"

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)
        # Update item quantity after movement
        item = self.item
        if self.movement_type == 'in':
            item.quantity = models.F('quantity') + self.quantity
        elif self.movement_type in ('out', 'return'):
            item.quantity = models.F('quantity') - self.quantity
        elif self.movement_type == 'adjustment':
            item.quantity = self.quantity  # direct set
        item.save(update_fields=['quantity'])
        item.refresh_from_db()

# ── PRIMKA (GOODS RECEIPT) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class GoodsReceipt(models.Model):
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('draft',     _('Nacrt')),
        ('confirmed', _('Potvrđena')),
        ('cancelled', _('Otkazana')),
    ]
    company         = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    objects         = CompanyManager()
    receipt_number  = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Broj primke'))
    supplier        = models.ForeignKey(
        'partners.Partner', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='goods_receipts', verbose_name=_('Dobavljač'),
    )
    date            = models.DateField(verbose_name=_('Datum primke'))
    document_number = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Broj dostavnice/fakture'))
    status          = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='draft', verbose_name=_('Status'))
    notes           = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Napomene'))
    created_by      = models.ForeignKey(
        User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Kreirao'),
    )
    created_at      = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at      = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    total_purchase  = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                           verbose_name=_('Ukupna nabavna vrijednost'))
    total_selling   = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                           verbose_name=_('Ukupna prodajna vrijednost'))

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Primka')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Primke')
        ordering            = ['-date', '-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"Primka {self.receipt_number} – {self.date}"

    def confirm(self):
        """Confirm receipt: update InventoryItem prices, create PriceChange + StockMovement records."""
        from django.db import transaction as _tx
        with _tx.atomic():
            total_purchase = Decimal('0')
            total_selling  = Decimal('0')
            for ri in self.items.select_related('inventory_item').all():
                item   = ri.inventory_item
                old_pp = item.purchase_price
                old_up = item.unit_price
                new_pp = ri.cost_price_unit.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
                new_up = ri.selling_price_gross.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
                item.purchase_price = new_pp
                item.unit_price     = new_up
                item.save(update_fields=['purchase_price', 'unit_price'])
                PriceChange.objects.create(
                    inventory_item=item,
                    goods_receipt=self,
                    old_purchase_price=old_pp,
                    new_purchase_price=new_pp,
                    old_unit_price=old_up,
                    new_unit_price=new_up,
                    changed_by=self.created_by,
                )
                StockMovement.objects.create(
                    item=item,
                    movement_type='in',
                    quantity=ri.quantity,
                    unit_price=new_pp,
                    reason=f'Primka {self.receipt_number}',
                    performed_by=self.created_by,
                )
                total_purchase += ri.total_cost_price
                total_selling  += ri.total_selling_gross
            self.status        = 'confirmed'
            self.total_purchase = total_purchase.quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
            self.total_selling  = total_selling.quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
            self.save(update_fields=['status', 'total_purchase', 'total_selling'])


class GoodsReceiptItem(models.Model):
    receipt        = models.ForeignKey(GoodsReceipt, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                        related_name='items', verbose_name=_('Primka'))
    inventory_item = models.ForeignKey(InventoryItem, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
                                        verbose_name=_('Artikl'))
    quantity       = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=3, default=1,
                                          verbose_name=_('Količina'))
    # Nabavna kalkulacija (HR/DE)
    purchase_price_unit  = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=4, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Nabavna cijena/jed.'))
    dependent_costs_unit = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=4, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Zavisni troškovi/jed.'))
    cost_price_unit      = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=4, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Nabavna cijena s troš.'))
    # Prodajni obračun
    margin_percent       = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6,  decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Marža (%)'))
    margin_amount        = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=4, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Iznos marže'))
    selling_price_net    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=4, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Prodajna cijena bez PDV'))
    tax_rate             = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5,  decimal_places=2, default=25,
                                                verbose_name=_('PDV stopa (%)'))
    selling_price_vat    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=4, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Iznos PDV-a'))
    selling_price_gross  = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=4, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('MPC (s PDV-om)'))
    # Ukupni iznosi retka
    total_purchase_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Uk. nabavna'))
    total_cost_price     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Uk. nabavna s troš.'))
    total_selling_gross  = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                                verbose_name=_('Uk. MPC'))

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Stavka primke')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Stavke primke')

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.inventory_item.name} × {self.quantity}"

    def calculate(self):
        R  = ROUND_HALF_UP
        pp = Decimal(str(self.purchase_price_unit  or 0))
        dc = Decimal(str(self.dependent_costs_unit or 0))
        cp = pp + dc
        self.cost_price_unit = cp
        mp = Decimal(str(self.margin_percent or 0))
        ma = (cp * mp / Decimal('100')).quantize(Decimal('0.0001'), rounding=R)
        self.margin_amount = ma
        sn = cp + ma
        self.selling_price_net = sn
        tp = Decimal(str(self.tax_rate or 0))
        va = (sn * tp / Decimal('100')).quantize(Decimal('0.0001'), rounding=R)
        self.selling_price_vat = va
        sg = (sn + va).quantize(Decimal('0.0001'), rounding=R)
        self.selling_price_gross = sg
        qty = Decimal(str(self.quantity or 0))
        self.total_purchase_price = (pp * qty).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=R)
        self.total_cost_price     = (cp * qty).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=R)
        self.total_selling_gross  = (sg * qty).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=R)

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.calculate()
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)


class PriceChange(models.Model):
    inventory_item     = models.ForeignKey(InventoryItem, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                            related_name='price_changes', verbose_name=_('Artikl'))
    goods_receipt      = models.ForeignKey(GoodsReceipt, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                            null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Primka'))
    old_purchase_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Stara nabavna'))
    new_purchase_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Nova nabavna'))
    old_unit_price     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Stara prodajna'))
    new_unit_price     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Nova prodajna'))
    changed_by         = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
                                            verbose_name=_('Promijenio'))
    created_at         = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Promjena cijene')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Promjene cijena')
        ordering            = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.inventory_item.name}: {self.old_unit_price}→{self.new_unit_price}"

class StockBatch(models.Model):
    """
    Physical batch of goods in the warehouse.
    Tracks expected weight, expiry, and quarantine status.
    FEFO (First Expired First Out) ordering by default.
    """
    QUARANTINE_CHOICES = [
        ('active', _('Aktivna')),
        ('quarantine', _('HACCP karantena')),
        ('disposed', _('Zbrinuto')),
    ]

    company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='stock_batches', verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    item = models.ForeignKey(
        InventoryItem, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='stock_batches', verbose_name=_('Artikl'),
    )
    batch_number = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Broj sarze / LOT'))
    expected_weight = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=10, decimal_places=3, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('Ocekivana tezina (kg)'),
    )
    actual_weight = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=10, decimal_places=3, null=True, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('Zadnja izmjerena tezina (kg)'),
    )
    quantity = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('Kolicina (kom)'),
    )
    expiry_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Datum isteka'))
    quarantine_status = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=QUARANTINE_CHOICES, default='active',
        verbose_name=_('Status'),
    )
    quarantine_reason = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Razlog karantene'))
    location = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Lokacija'))
    last_counted_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Zadnje brojanje'))
    last_counted_by = models.ForeignKey(
        'auth.User', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Zadnje brojao'),
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Sarzna zaliha')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Sarzne zalihe')
        ordering = ['expiry_date', 'created_at']  # FEFO

    def __str__(self):
        exp = self.expiry_date.strftime('%d.%m.%Y') if self.expiry_date else 'bez roka'
        return f"{self.item.name} LOT:{self.batch_number} ({exp})"

    @property
    def is_expired(self):
        if not self.expiry_date:
            return False
        from datetime import date
        return self.expiry_date < date.today()

    @property
    def kalo_tolerance(self):
        """Max allowed weight loss from kalo (percentage from item)."""
        return self.item.kalo_percent or 0

    @property
    def min_acceptable_weight(self):
        """Minimum weight before triggering theft alert."""
        if not self.expected_weight:
            return 0
        tol = self.kalo_tolerance
        return float(self.expected_weight) * (1 - float(tol) / 100)

    def check_quarantine(self):
        """Auto-quarantine if expired."""
        if self.is_expired and self.quarantine_status == 'active':
            self.quarantine_status = 'quarantine'
            self.quarantine_reason = 'Automatska karantena: istekao rok trajanja'
            self.save(update_fields=['quarantine_status', 'quarantine_reason', 'updated_at'])
            return True
        return False


class InventoryCountLog(models.Model):
    """Audit trail for every inventory count submitted."""
    RESULT_CHOICES = [
        ('ok', _('U redu')),
        ('kalo', _('Prirodni kalo')),
        ('theft_alert', _('Upozorenje: moguca kradja')),
        ('surplus', _('Visak')),
    ]

    company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    batch = models.ForeignKey(
        'StockBatch', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='count_logs', verbose_name=_('Sarza'),
    )
    expected_weight = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=3, verbose_name=_('Ocekivana tezina'))
    actual_weight = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=3, verbose_name=_('Izmjerena tezina'))
    difference_kg = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=3, verbose_name=_('Razlika (kg)'))
    difference_pct = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Razlika (%)'))
    kalo_tolerance_pct = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Tolerancija kala (%)'))
    result = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=RESULT_CHOICES, verbose_name=_('Rezultat'))
    counted_by = models.ForeignKey(
        'auth.User', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, verbose_name=_('Brojao'),
    )
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Napomena'))
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Zapisnik inventure')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Zapisnici inventure')
        ordering = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"Count {self.batch} -> {self.result} ({self.difference_pct}%)"

import uuid

    date_issued = models.DateField(verbose_name=_("Datum izdavanja"))

        verbose_name = _("Dokument")
        verbose_name_plural = _("Dokumenti")

    def __str__(self):

class GrossmarktDocument(models.Model):
    """Bazni model za procesne dokumente."""
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('draft', _('Nacrt')),
        ('confirmed', _('Potvrđeno')),
        ('cancelled', _('Stornirano')),
    ]
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    company = models.ForeignKey(Company, on_delete=models.CASCADE, verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'))
    objects = CompanyManager()
    partner = models.ForeignKey(Partner, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Partner'))
    doc_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, db_index=True, verbose_name=_('Broj dokumenta'))
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='draft')
    date_issued = models.DateField(verbose_name=_('Datum izdavanja'))
    date_confirmed = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Datum potvrde'))
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Napomena'))
    created_by = models.ForeignKey('auth.User', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='%(class)s_created', verbose_name=_('Kreirao'))
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        abstract = True
        ordering = ['-created_at']

    def confirm(self):
        from django.utils import timezone as tz
        self.status = 'confirmed'
        self.date_confirmed = tz.now()
        self.save(update_fields=['status', 'date_confirmed', 'updated_at'])

    def cancel(self):
        self.status = 'cancelled'
        self.save(update_fields=['status', 'updated_at'])

    @property
    def total(self):
        return sum(i.line_total for i in self.items.all())

    @property
    def total_vat(self):
        return sum(i.vat_amount for i in self.items.all())

    @property
    def total_with_vat(self):
        return self.total + self.total_vat


class GrossmarktDocItem(models.Model):
    """Bazna stavka za procesne dokumente."""
    product_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, verbose_name=_('Naziv'))
    quantity = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Količina'))
    unit = models.CharField(max_length=20, default='kg', verbose_name=_('Jed. mjere'))
    unit_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Jed. cijena'))
    vat_rate = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=25, verbose_name=_('PDV %'))
    discount_pct = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Popust %'))

    class Meta:
        abstract = True

    @property
    def line_total(self):
        base = float(self.quantity * self.unit_price)
        if self.discount_pct:
            base -= base * float(self.discount_pct) / 100
        return round(base, 2)

    @property
    def vat_amount(self):
        return round(self.line_total * float(self.vat_rate) / 100, 2)

    @property
    def line_total_with_vat(self):
        return round(self.line_total + self.vat_amount, 2)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.product_name} x {self.quantity} {self.unit}"

"""
traceability/models.py - Farm-to-Fork traceability

Svaki proizvod ima lanac događaja od berbe do stola.
Gost u restoranu skenira QR → vidi cijeli put proizvoda.
"""
import uuid

from django.conf import settings
from django.db import models
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _


class ProductTrace(models.Model):
    """Kompletna traceability za jedan proizvod u jednoj narudžbi."""
    # Veze
    product = models.ForeignKey(
        'marketplace.MarketplaceProduct', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='traces', verbose_name=_('Proizvod')
    )
    order_item = models.ForeignKey(
        'marketplace.MarketplaceOrderItem', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='traces',
        verbose_name=_('Stavka narudžbe')
    )

    # Proizvođač
    producer_company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        verbose_name=_('Proizvođač (OPG)')
    )
    producer_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, verbose_name=_('Naziv OPG-a'))
    producer_region = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Regija'))
    producer_story = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Priča o OPG-u'))
    producer_photo = models.ImageField(upload_to='traceability/producers/', blank=True, null=True)

    # Proizvodnja
    harvest_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Datum berbe'))
    production_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Datum proizvodnje'))
    lot_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Broj šarže'))
    is_organic = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Ekološki'))
    certifications = models.JSONField(default=list, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Certifikati'))

    # Transport
    cold_chain_maintained = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name=_('Hladni lanac održan'))
    temp_log = models.JSONField(default=list, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Temp log'))
    pickup_datetime = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    delivery_datetime = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    transport_duration_hours = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=1, null=True, blank=True)

    # QR
    qr_code = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, unique=True, verbose_name=_('QR kod'))
    trace_url = models.URLField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Javni URL'))

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Trag proizvoda')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Tragovi proizvoda')
        ordering = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"Trace: {self.product.name} ← {self.producer_name}"

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self.trace_url:
            self.trace_url = f"https://limit-connect.com/trace/{self.qr_code}/"
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)


class TraceEvent(models.Model):
    """Pojedinačni događaj u lancu traceability-ja."""
    EVENT_TYPES = [
        ('harvested', _('Ubrano / Proizvedeno')),
        ('stored', _('Uskladišteno')),
        ('ordered', _('Naručeno')),
        ('picked_up', _('Preuzeto od OPG-a')),
        ('in_transit', _('U transportu')),
        ('temp_check', _('Provjera temperature')),
        ('delivered', _('Dostavljeno restoranu')),
        ('received', _('Zaprimljeno')),
        ('prepared', _('Pripremljeno u kuhinji')),
        ('served', _('Servirano gostu')),
    ]

    trace = models.ForeignKey(
        ProductTrace, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='events', verbose_name=_('Trag')
    )
    event_type = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=EVENT_TYPES)
    timestamp = models.DateTimeField()

    location_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    latitude = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=7, null=True, blank=True)
    longitude = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=7, null=True, blank=True)
    temperature = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=1, null=True, blank=True)

    performed_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Izvršio')
    )
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True)
    photo = models.ImageField(upload_to='traceability/events/', blank=True, null=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Događaj traga')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Događaji traga')
        ordering = ['trace', 'timestamp']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.get_event_type_display()} @ {self.timestamp:%d.%m. %H:%M}"

"""EDIK — e-Porezna status tracking."""
from django.db import models
from django.conf import settings


class TaxFormType(models.Model):
    """Vrsta poreznog obrasca."""
    FREQUENCY_CHOICES = [
        ('monthly', 'Mjesecno'),
        ('quarterly', 'Kvartalno'),
        ('yearly', 'Godisnje'),
    ]
    code = models.CharField(max_length=20, unique=True)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    frequency = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=FREQUENCY_CHOICES)
    deadline_day = models.IntegerField(default=20,
        help_text='Dan u mjesecu do kad treba predati')
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['code']
        verbose_name = 'Vrsta obrasca'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Vrste obrazaca'

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.code} — {self.name}'


class TaxSubmission(models.Model):
    """Evidencija predaje poreznog obrasca."""
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('draft', 'Priprema'),
        ('ready', 'Spremno za predaju'),
        ('submitted', 'Predano'),
        ('accepted', 'Prihvaceno'),
        ('rejected', 'Odbijeno'),
        ('correction', 'Ispravak predan'),
    ]

    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                 related_name='tax_submissions')
    form_type = models.ForeignKey(TaxFormType, on_delete=models.PROTECT)
    period_year = models.IntegerField()
    period_month = models.IntegerField(null=True, blank=True)
    period_quarter = models.IntegerField(null=True, blank=True)

    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='draft')

    prepared_date = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    submitted_date = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    response_date = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    deadline_date = models.DateField()

    xml_file = models.FileField(upload_to='edik/submissions/', blank=True)
    response_xml = models.FileField(upload_to='edik/responses/', blank=True)

    submitted_by = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                      null=True, blank=True)
    reference_number = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    rejection_reason = models.TextField(blank=True)
    amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True)
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True)

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        unique_together = [('company', 'form_type', 'period_year', 'period_month')]
        ordering = ['-period_year', '-period_month', 'form_type__code']
        verbose_name = 'Predaja obrasca'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Predaje obrazaca'

    def __str__(self):
        period = f'{self.period_month:02d}/{self.period_year}' if self.period_month else str(self.period_year)
        return f'{self.form_type.code} {period} — {self.get_status_display()}'

    @property
    def is_overdue(self):
        from datetime import date
        return self.status in ('draft', 'ready') and self.deadline_date < date.today()


class TaxCalendar(models.Model):
    """Porezni kalendar — rokovi predaje."""
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                 related_name='tax_calendar')
    form_type = models.ForeignKey(TaxFormType, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    period_year = models.IntegerField()
    period_month = models.IntegerField(null=True, blank=True)
    deadline = models.DateField()
    is_completed = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    submission = models.ForeignKey(TaxSubmission, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                    null=True, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['deadline']
        verbose_name = 'Porezni rok'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Porezni rokovi'

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.form_type.code} — rok {self.deadline}'

    archive_days = models.IntegerField(default=4015, verbose_name='Cuvaj arhivu (dana)', help_text='Zakonski min 11 godina = 4015 dana')

    # API pristup za vanjske klijente
    api_key = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True, unique=True, verbose_name='API kljuc')
    api_enabled = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name='API pristup aktivan')
    api_rate_limit = models.IntegerField(default=100, verbose_name='Max zahtjeva/sat')

    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'e-Racun konfiguracija'
        verbose_name_plural = 'e-Racun konfiguracije'

    def __str__(self):
        return f'e-Racun: {self.company.name}'

    def save(self, **kwargs):
        if not self.api_key:
            import secrets
            self.api_key = secrets.token_urlsafe(48)
        super().save(**kwargs)

        ('error', 'Greska'),
        ('archived', 'Arhiviran'),
    ]

    DOC_TYPES = [
        ('380', 'Racun (Commercial Invoice)'),
        ('381', 'Odobrenje (Credit Note)'),
        ('383', 'Terecenje (Debit Note)'),
        ('386', 'Predracun (Prepayment Invoice)'),
    ]

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='eracuni')

    # Veza s LIMIT Connect fakturom (opcionalno - moze doci i preko API-ja)
    invoice = models.OneToOneField(
        'invoicing.Invoice', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='eracun'
    )

    # Dokument
    doc_type = models.CharField(max_length=3, choices=DOC_TYPES, default='380')
    invoice_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, verbose_name='Broj racuna')
    issue_date = models.DateField(verbose_name='Datum izdavanja')
    delivery_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name='Datum isporuke')
    due_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name='Rok placanja')
    currency = models.CharField(max_length=3, default='EUR')

    # Izdavatelj
    issuer_name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    issuer_oib = models.CharField(max_length=11)

    issuer_postal = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True)
    issuer_country = models.CharField(max_length=2, default='HR')
    issuer_iban = models.CharField(max_length=34, blank=True)
    issuer_swift = models.CharField(max_length=11, blank=True)

    # Primatelj
    recipient_name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    recipient_oib = models.CharField(max_length=20)  # moze biti i VAT ID za EU
    recipient_address = models.CharField(max_length=300, blank=True)
    recipient_city = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    recipient_postal = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True)
    recipient_country = models.CharField(max_length=2, default='HR')

    # Iznosi
    subtotal = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    tax_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)

    # Placanje
    payment_means_code = models.CharField(max_length=3, default='30', help_text='30=transfer, 48=card, 10=cash')
    payment_reference = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, verbose_name='Poziv na broj')
    payment_model = models.CharField(max_length=4, blank=True, default='HR00', verbose_name='Model placanja')
    note = models.TextField(blank=True)

    # Fiskalizacija
    zki = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True, verbose_name='ZKI')
    jir = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True, verbose_name='JIR')

    # Status i rezultat
    status = models.CharField(max_length=15, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='draft')
    error_message = models.TextField(blank=True)
    error_code = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True)
    fina_uuid = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True, verbose_name='FINA UUID')

    # Anomaly detection
    anomaly_score = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True)
    risk_level = models.CharField(max_length=10, blank=True)  # low/medium/high

    # XML arhiva
    xml_request = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name='XML zahtjev')
    xml_response = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name='XML odgovor')

    # Timestamps
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    accepted_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    archived_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        'auth.User', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True
    )

    objects = CompanyManager()

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'e-Racun'
        verbose_name_plural = 'e-Racuni'
        ordering = ['-created_at']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['company', 'status']),
            models.Index(fields=['invoice_number']),
            models.Index(fields=['issuer_oib']),
            models.Index(fields=['recipient_oib']),
        ]

        return f'{self.invoice_number} -> {self.recipient_name} ({self.get_status_display()})'


class ERacunItem(models.Model):
    """Line item on an e-Racun - EN 16931 compliant."""

--- ./work_orders/models.py ---
from django.db import models
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _
from core.managers import CompanyManager


class WorkOrder(models.Model):
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('draft',       _('Nacrt')),
        ('in_progress', _('U tijeku')),
        ('completed',   _('Završen')),
        ('invoiced',    _('Fakturiran')),
        ('cancelled',   _('Otkazan')),
    ]
    PRIORITY_CHOICES = [
        ('low',    _('Nisko')),
        ('normal', _('Normalno')),
        ('high',   _('Visoko')),
        ('urgent', _('Hitno')),
    ]

    company         = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    objects         = CompanyManager()

    order_number    = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Broj naloga'))
    date            = models.DateField(auto_now_add=True, verbose_name=_('Datum'))
    status          = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='draft', verbose_name=_('Status'))
    client          = models.ForeignKey(
        'partners.Partner', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='work_orders', verbose_name=_('Klijent'),
    )
    assigned_to     = models.ForeignKey(
        User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='assigned_work_orders', verbose_name=_('Dodijeljen'),
    )
    description     = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Opis radova'))
    notes           = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Napomene'))
    priority        = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=PRIORITY_CHOICES, default='normal', verbose_name=_('Prioritet'))
    estimated_hours = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Procijenjeni sati'))
    actual_hours    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Stvarni sati'))
    scheduled_date  = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Planirani datum'))
    scheduled_time  = models.TimeField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Planirano vrijeme'))
    completed_date  = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Datum završetka'))
    deadline        = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Rok'))
    # Totals (recalculated on save)
    total_labor     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Ukupno rad'))
    total_materials = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Ukupno materijal'))
    discount        = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Popust (%)'))
    total_net       = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Neto'))
    total_vat       = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('PDV'))
    total_gross     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Bruto'))
    invoice         = models.ForeignKey(
        'invoicing.Invoice', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='work_orders', verbose_name=_('Račun'),
    )
    created_by      = models.ForeignKey(
        User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='work_orders_created', verbose_name=_('Kreirao'),
    )
    created_at      = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at      = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Radni nalog')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Radni nalozi')
        ordering            = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.order_number or 'RN-???'} — {self.client or 'Bez klijenta'}"

    def generate_order_number(self):
        import datetime
        year = datetime.date.today().year
        last = WorkOrder.objects.filter(
            company=self.company,
            order_number__startswith=f'RN-{year}-',
        ).order_by('-order_number').first()
        if last and last.order_number:
            try:
                seq = int(last.order_number.split('-')[-1]) + 1
            except ValueError:
                seq = 1
        else:
            seq = 1
        return f'RN-{year}-{seq:04d}'

    def recalculate_totals(self):
        from decimal import Decimal
        labor = Decimal('0')
        materials = Decimal('0')
        total_net = Decimal('0')
        total_vat = Decimal('0')
        for item in self.items.all():
            net = item.total_net
            vat = net * item.tax_rate / Decimal('100')
            total_net += net
            total_vat += vat
            if item.item_type == 'labor':
                labor += net
            else:
                materials += net
        disc_factor = (Decimal('100') - self.discount) / Decimal('100')
        self.total_labor     = (labor     * disc_factor).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
        self.total_materials = (materials * disc_factor).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
        self.total_net       = (total_net * disc_factor).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
        self.total_vat       = (total_vat * disc_factor).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
        self.total_gross     = (self.total_net + self.total_vat).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
        self.save(update_fields=['total_labor', 'total_materials', 'total_net', 'total_vat', 'total_gross'])

    def complete(self):
        import datetime
        self.status = 'completed'
        self.completed_date = datetime.datetime.now()
        self.save(update_fields=['status', 'completed_date'])

    @property
    def status_color(self):
        return {
            'draft':       '#64748b',
            'in_progress': '#3b82f6',
            'completed':   '#22c55e',
            'invoiced':    '#c9a84c',
            'cancelled':   '#ef4444',
        }.get(self.status, '#64748b')

    @property
    def priority_color(self):
        return {
            'low':    '#64748b',
            'normal': '#94a3b8',
            'high':   '#f59e0b',
            'urgent': '#ef4444',
        }.get(self.priority, '#94a3b8')


class WorkOrderItem(models.Model):
    ITEM_TYPES = [
        ('labor',    _('Rad / Usluga')),
        ('material', _('Materijal')),
    ]

    work_order      = models.ForeignKey(WorkOrder, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                         related_name='items', verbose_name=_('Radni nalog'))
    item_type       = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=ITEM_TYPES, default='labor',
                                        verbose_name=_('Tip stavke'))
    article         = models.ForeignKey(
        'inventory.InventoryItem', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Artikl iz zalihe'),
    )
    description     = models.CharField(max_length=200, verbose_name=_('Opis'))
    quantity        = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=1, verbose_name=_('Količina'))
    unit            = models.CharField(max_length=20, default='sat', verbose_name=_('JMJ'))
    unit_price      = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Cijena/jed.'))
    discount_percent = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Popust (%)'))
    tax_rate        = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=25, verbose_name=_('PDV (%)'))
    total_net       = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Neto'))
    total_gross     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Bruto'))
    bom_deducted    = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('BOM razduženo'))

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Stavka radnog naloga')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Stavke radnog naloga')
        ordering            = ['item_type', 'id']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.description} × {self.quantity} {self.unit}"

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        from decimal import Decimal
        net = self.quantity * self.unit_price * (Decimal('100') - self.discount_percent) / Decimal('100')
        vat = net * self.tax_rate / Decimal('100')
        self.total_net   = net.quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
        self.total_gross = (net + vat).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)
