from django.conf import settings


class PDVSReport(models.Model):
    """Generiran PDV-S obrazac za period."""
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('draft', 'Nacrt'),
        ('final', 'Finalizirano'),
        ('submitted', 'Predano'),
        ('accepted', 'Prihvaceno'),
    ]

    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                 related_name='pdvs_reports')
    year = models.IntegerField()
    month = models.IntegerField()
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='draft')

    # I. PRIMLJENE ISPORUKE (input)
    i1_base = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='I.1 Tuzemne isporuke - osnovica')
    i1_tax = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='I.1 Tuzemne isporuke - pretporez')
    i2_base = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='I.2 Stjecanje iz EU - osnovica')
    i2_tax = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='I.2 Stjecanje iz EU - pretporez')
    i3_base = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='I.3 Uvoz - osnovica')
    i3_tax = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='I.3 Uvoz - pretporez')

    # II. OBAVLJENE ISPORUKE (output)
    ii1_base = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='II.1 Oporezive 25% - osnovica')
    ii1_tax = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='II.1 Oporezive 25% - PDV')
    ii2_base = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='II.2 Oporezive 13% - osnovica')
    ii2_tax = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='II.2 Oporezive 13% - PDV')
    ii3_base = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='II.3 Oporezive 5% - osnovica')
    ii3_tax = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='II.3 Oporezive 5% - PDV')
    ii4_base = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='II.4 Oslobodene isporuke')
    ii5_base = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='II.5 Isporuke u EU')
    ii6_base = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='II.6 Izvoz (trece zemlje)')

    # III. PRETPOREZ (input VAT totals)
    iii_total_pretporez = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    iii_ispravak = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='III.4 Ispravak pretporeza')

    # IV. OBVEZA
    iv_pdv_isporuke = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='IV.1 Ukupni PDV na isporuke')
    iv_pretporez = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='IV.2 Ukupni pretporez')
    iv_razlika = models.DecimalField(max_digits=14, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='IV.3 Razlika (+ uplata / - povrat)')

    # Meta
    generated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    generated_by = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                      null=True, blank=True)
    xml_file = models.FileField(upload_to='pdv_s/exports/', blank=True)
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True)

    class Meta:
        unique_together = [('company', 'year', 'month')]
        ordering = ['-year', '-month']
        verbose_name = 'PDV-S Obrazac'
        verbose_name_plural = 'PDV-S Obrasci'

    def __str__(self):
        return f'PDV-S {self.month:02d}/{self.year} — {self.company.name}'

"""
POS Kasa — Point of Sale module
Podržava HR fiskalizaciju, bar kod skeniranje i integraciju s invoicing app.
"""
import uuid
from decimal import Decimal

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.db import models
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _

from core.managers import CompanyManager


class POSTerminal(models.Model):
    """
    Fizička blagajna / kasa.
    Jedna tvrtka može imati više kasa (npr. Kasa 1, Kasa 2).
    Svaka kasa je vezana uz BusinessLocation radi fiskalizacije.
    """
    company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='pos_terminals',
        verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    objects = CompanyManager()
    business_location = models.ForeignKey(
        'invoicing.BusinessLocation', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='pos_terminals',
        verbose_name=_('Poslovni prostor (za fiskalizaciju)'),
    )
    name          = models.CharField(max_length=100, verbose_name=_('Naziv kase'), help_text='Npr. Kasa 1, Šank, Blagajna')
    terminal_code = models.CharField(max_length=20, verbose_name=_('Kod terminala'), help_text='Jedinstveni kod npr. KS001')
    description   = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Opis / Lokacija'))
    is_active     = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name=_('Aktivna'))
    branch        = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.CompanyBranch',
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='pos_terminals',
        verbose_name='Podružnica',
    )
    pos_type      = models.CharField(
        max_length=10,
        choices=[('quick', 'Brza blagajna'), ('retail', 'Maloprodaja'), ('restaurant', 'Restoran')],
        default='retail',
        verbose_name=_('Tip POS sučelja'),
    )
    created_at    = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('POS terminal (kasa)')
        verbose_name_plural = _('POS terminali (kase)')
        unique_together     = [('company', 'terminal_code')]
        ordering            = ['company', 'name']

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.name} ({self.terminal_code})'


class POSSession(models.Model):
    """
    Smjena / dnevno otvaranje blagajne.
    Svaka smjena se otvara i zatvara — obavezno za fiskalizaciju (Z-izvješće).
    """
    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        OPEN   = 'open',   _('Otvorena')
        CLOSED = 'closed', _('Zatvorena')
        Z_DONE = 'z_done', _('Z-izvješće generirano')

    terminal      = models.ForeignKey(POSTerminal, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                       related_name='sessions', verbose_name=_('Terminal'))
    operator      = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                       null=True, related_name='pos_sessions', verbose_name=_('Operater'))
    session_number = models.PositiveIntegerField(verbose_name=_('Broj smjene'))

    opened_at     = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True, verbose_name=_('Otvorena u'))
    closed_at     = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Zatvorena u'))

    opening_cash  = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                         verbose_name=_('Gotovina pri otvaranju (€)'))
    closing_cash  = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                         verbose_name=_('Prebrojana gotovina pri zatvaranju (€)'))

    status        = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=Status.choices,
                                      default=Status.OPEN, verbose_name=_('Status'))
    z_report_number = models.PositiveIntegerField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Broj Z-izvješća'))
    notes         = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Napomene'))

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('POS smjena')
        verbose_name_plural = _('POS smjene')
        unique_together     = [('terminal', 'session_number')]
        ordering            = ['-opened_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f'Smjena #{self.session_number} – {self.terminal} ({self.get_status_display()})'

    @property
    def total_sales(self):
        return self.receipts.filter(
            status=POSReceipt.Status.PAID
        ).aggregate(models.Sum('total'))['total__sum'] or Decimal('0.00')

    @property
    def total_cash_sales(self):
        return self.receipts.filter(
            status=POSReceipt.Status.PAID,
            payment_lines__method=POSPaymentLine.Method.CASH,
        ).aggregate(models.Sum('payment_lines__amount'))['payment_lines__amount__sum'] or Decimal('0.00')

    @property
    def total_deposits_amount(self):
        return sum(d.amount for d in self.cash_deposits.filter(deposit_type='deposit'))

    @property
    def total_withdrawals_amount(self):
        return sum(d.amount for d in self.cash_deposits.filter(deposit_type='withdrawal'))

    @property
    def expected_closing_cash(self):
        return self.opening_cash + self.total_cash_sales + self.total_deposits_amount - self.total_withdrawals_amount

    @property
    def cash_difference(self):
        return self.closing_cash - self.expected_closing_cash


class POSReceipt(models.Model):
    """
    Jedan račun / bon na blagajni.
    Automatski kreira Invoice (+ fiskalizira ga za HR).
    """
    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        OPEN      = 'open',      _('Otvoreni bon')
        PAID      = 'paid',      _('Plaćen')
        CANCELLED = 'cancelled', _('Storniran / Otkazan')
        REFUNDED  = 'refunded',  _('Povrat')

    uuid           = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, unique=True, editable=False)
    session        = models.ForeignKey(POSSession, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                        related_name='receipts', verbose_name=_('Smjena'))
    receipt_number = models.PositiveIntegerField(verbose_name=_('Broj bona'))

    # Veza na Invoice (kreira se automatski pri plaćanju + fiskalizira)
    invoice        = models.OneToOneField(
        'invoicing.Invoice', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='pos_receipt',
        verbose_name=_('Fiskalni račun'),
    )

    # Iznosi (denormalizirani za brzinu)
    subtotal   = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Iznos bez PDV'))
    tax_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('PDV'))
    total      = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Ukupno'))
    discount   = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Popust'))

    status     = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=Status.choices,
                                   default=Status.OPEN, verbose_name=_('Status'))
    table_number = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Stol / Zona'),
                                     help_text=_('Za ugostiteljstvo: broj stola'))
    note       = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Napomena na bonu'))

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    paid_at        = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Plaćen u'))
    cancel_reason  = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Razlog storniranja'))

    # Fiskalizacija (FINA CIS)
    zki            = models.CharField(max_length=32, null=True, blank=True,
                                       verbose_name='ZKI (Zaštitni kod izdavatelja)')
    jir            = models.CharField(max_length=40, null=True, blank=True,
                                       verbose_name='JIR (Jedinstveni identifikator računa)')
    fiscal_datetime = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True,
                                            verbose_name='Datum/vrijeme fiskalizacije')

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('POS bon / račun')
        verbose_name_plural = _('POS bonovi / računi')
        unique_together     = [('session', 'receipt_number')]
        ordering            = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f'Bon #{self.receipt_number} – {self.total} EUR ({self.get_status_display()})'

    def recalculate(self):
        """Reizračunaj iznose iz stavki."""
        items = self.items.all()
        self.subtotal = sum(
            i.quantity * i.unit_price * (1 - i.discount_percent / 100)
            for i in items
        )
        self.tax_amount = sum(
            i.quantity * i.unit_price * (1 - i.discount_percent / 100) * (i.tax_rate / 100)
            for i in items
        )
        self.total = self.subtotal + self.tax_amount - self.discount
        return self


class POSReceiptItem(models.Model):
    """
    Stavka na bonu — artikl skeniran barkodom ili dodan ručno.
    """
    receipt        = models.ForeignKey(POSReceipt, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                        related_name='items', verbose_name=_('Bon'))
    # Direktna veza na artikl iz zalihe (via barcode scan)
    inventory_item = models.ForeignKey(
        'inventory.InventoryItem', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='pos_items',
        verbose_name=_('Artikl (zaliha)'),
    )
    barcode        = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Barkod'),
                                       help_text=_('Uneseno skeniranjem'))
    description    = models.CharField(max_length=255, verbose_name=_('Naziv artikla'))
    quantity       = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=3, default=1, verbose_name=_('Količina'))
    unit           = models.CharField(max_length=20, default='kom', verbose_name=_('Jed.mjera'))
    unit_price     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Cijena bez PDV'))
    discount_percent = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Popust %'))
    tax_rate       = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=25, verbose_name=_('PDV %'))
    tax_rate_obj   = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.TaxRate', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('PDV stopa'),
    )

    # ── DSFinV-K flags (auto-set from InventoryItem ili rucno) ────────────
    is_pfand_return = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        verbose_name=_("Povrat Pfanda"),
        help_text=_("Negativan iznos — DSFinV-K GV_TYP=Pfandrueckzahlung"),
    )
    is_tip = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        verbose_name=_("Napojnica"),
        help_text=_("DSFinV-K GV_TYP=TrinkgeldAN ili TrinkgeldAG"),
    )
    is_tip_employer = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        verbose_name=_("Napojnica vlasnika (AG)"),
    )

    total_price    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                          verbose_name=_('Ukupno s PDV'))

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Stavka bona')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Stavke bona')

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.description} x{self.quantity} = {self.total_price}'

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.tax_rate_obj_id:
            self.tax_rate = self.tax_rate_obj.rate
        if self.inventory_item_id and self.inventory_item:
            if not self.description:
                self.description = self.inventory_item.name
            if not self.barcode:
                self.barcode = self.inventory_item.barcode
        net = Decimal(str(self.quantity)) * Decimal(str(self.unit_price)) * (
            1 - Decimal(str(self.discount_percent)) / 100
        )
        self.total_price = round(net * (1 + Decimal(str(self.tax_rate)) / 100), 2)
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)


class POSPaymentLine(models.Model):
    """
    Kako je plaćen bon — podržava split plaćanja (npr. 20€ gotovina + 30€ kartica).
    """
    class Method(models.TextChoices):
        CASH       = 'CASH',       _('Gotovina')
        CARD       = 'CARD',       _('Kartica')
        MOBILE     = 'MOBILE',     _('Mobilno plaćanje (mPOS)')
        VOUCHER    = 'VOUCHER',    _('Bon / Voucher')
        ACCOUNT    = 'ACCOUNT',    _('Na račun (klijent)')

    receipt        = models.ForeignKey(POSReceipt, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                        related_name='payment_lines', verbose_name=_('Bon'))
    method         = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=Method.choices, verbose_name=_('Način plaćanja'))
    amount         = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Iznos'))
    change_given   = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                          verbose_name=_('Vraćeno kusur'))
    card_reference = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True,
                                       verbose_name=_('Referenca kartice / autorizacijski kod'))
    created_at     = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Linija plaćanja')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Linije plaćanja')

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.get_method_display()} {self.amount} EUR'

class POSCashier(models.Model):
    """Blagajnik s PIN kodom i dozvolama."""
    company      = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='pos_cashiers', verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    name         = models.CharField(max_length=100, verbose_name=_('Ime blagajnika'))
    pin_hash     = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True, verbose_name=_('PIN hash'))
    can_void     = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Može stornirati'))
    can_discount = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Može davati popust'))
    max_discount_percent = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Max popust (%)'),
    )
    is_active    = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name=_('Aktivan'))
    created_at   = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('POS blagajnik')
        verbose_name_plural = _('POS blagajnici')
        ordering            = ['name']

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name

    def set_pin(self, pin_str):
        import hashlib
        self.pin_hash = hashlib.sha256(pin_str.strip().encode()).hexdigest()

    def check_pin(self, pin_str):
        import hashlib
        return self.pin_hash == hashlib.sha256(pin_str.strip().encode()).hexdigest()

class Table(models.Model):
    TABLE_TYPES = [
        ('table', _('Stol')),
        ('bar', _('Sank')),
        ('terrace', _('Terasa')),
        ('room', _('Soba')),
        ('vip', _('VIP')),
    ]
    company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='gastro_tables', verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    objects = CompanyManager()
    branch = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.CompanyBranch', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='gastro_tables',
        verbose_name=_('Podruznica'),
    )
    name = models.CharField(max_length=50, verbose_name=_('Naziv'))
    table_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=10, choices=TABLE_TYPES, default='table',
        verbose_name=_('Tip'),
    )
    capacity = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=4, verbose_name=_('Kapacitet'))
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name=_('Aktivan'))
    is_occupied = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Zauzet'))
    qr_code = models.CharField(
        max_length=64, unique=True, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('QR kod'),
    )
    floor = models.CharField(max_length=30, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Kat / Zona'))

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Stol')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Stolovi')
        ordering = ['floor', 'name']

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.name} ({self.get_table_type_display()})'

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self.qr_code:
            self.qr_code = uuid.uuid4().hex[:16]
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)


class GastroOrder(models.Model):
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('new', _('Nova')),
        ('confirmed', _('Potvrdena')),
        ('preparing', _('U pripremi')),
        ('ready', _('Gotovo')),
        ('delivering', _('Na putu')),
        ('delivered', _('Dostavljeno')),
        ('paid', _('Placeno')),
        ('cancelled', _('Otkazano')),
    ]
    company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='gastro_orders', verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    objects = CompanyManager()
    table = models.ForeignKey(
        'pos.Table', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='orders',
        verbose_name=_('Stol'),
    )
    receipt = models.ForeignKey(
        'pos.POSReceipt', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='gastro_orders',
        verbose_name=_('POS Bon'),
    )
    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=12, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='new',
        verbose_name=_('Status'),
    )
    guest_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Ime gosta'))
    guest_phone = models.CharField(max_length=30, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Telefon'))

        'auth.User', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='claimed_orders',
        verbose_name=_('Preuzeo konobar'),
    )
    claimed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Vrijeme preuzimanja'))
    delivered_by = models.ForeignKey(
        'auth.User', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name='delivered_orders',
        verbose_name=_('Dostavio konobar'),
    )
    delivered_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Vrijeme dostave'))
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Napomene'))
    tracking_token = models.CharField(
        max_length=32, unique=True, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('Token pracenja'),
    )
    estimated_ready_time = models.DateTimeField(
        null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Predvideno vrijeme'),
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Gastro narudzba')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Gastro narudzbe')
        ordering = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        tbl = self.table.name if self.table else 'N/A'
        return f'Narudzba #{self.pk} - {tbl} ({self.get_status_display()})'

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self.tracking_token:
            self.tracking_token = uuid.uuid4().hex[:32]
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    stamps = models.IntegerField(default=0, verbose_name=_('Pecati'))

    total_spent = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    last_visit = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

        return f'{self.guest_email} - {self.program.name} ({self.stamps}/{self.program.stamps_required})'

    @property
    def has_reward(self):
        return self.stamps >= self.program.stamps_required

    @property
    def stamps_remaining(self):
        return max(0, self.program.stamps_required - self.stamps)

class WaiterShift(models.Model):
    """Tracks waiter shifts with heartbeat pings every 5 min."""
    user = models.ForeignKey(
        'auth.User', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='waiter_shifts', verbose_name=_('Konobar'),
    )
    company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='waiter_shifts', verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    objects = CompanyManager()
    started_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True, verbose_name=_('Pocetak smjene'))
    ended_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Kraj smjene'))
    last_heartbeat = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True, verbose_name=_('Zadnji ping'))
    heartbeat_count = models.IntegerField(default=0, verbose_name=_('Broj pingova'))
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name=_('Aktivna'))
    total_orders_claimed = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    total_orders_delivered = models.IntegerField(default=0)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Smjena konobara')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Smjene konobara')
        ordering = ['-started_at']

    def __str__(self):
        name = self.user.get_full_name() or self.user.username
        return f'{name} - {self.started_at:%d.%m. %H:%M}'

    @property
    def duration_minutes(self):
        from django.utils import timezone
        end = self.ended_at or timezone.now()
        return int((end - self.started_at).total_seconds() / 60)

    @property
    def duration_display(self):
        mins = self.duration_minutes
        h, m = divmod(mins, 60)
        return f'{h}h {m:02d}min'

    @property
    def is_heartbeat_stale(self):
        from django.utils import timezone
        if not self.is_active:
            return False
        return (timezone.now() - self.last_heartbeat).total_seconds() > 600  # 10 min = 2 missed

class ExpiryBatch(models.Model):
    company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='expiry_batches', verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    objects = CompanyManager()
    inventory_item = models.ForeignKey(
        'inventory.InventoryItem', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='expiry_batches', verbose_name=_('Artikl'),
    )
    batch_number = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Broj sarze'))
    quantity = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name=_('Kolicina'),
    )
    expiry_date = models.DateField(verbose_name=_('Datum isteka'))
    alert_days_before = models.PositiveIntegerField(
        default=3, verbose_name=_('Upozorenje dana prije'),
    )
    is_removed = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Uklonjeno'))

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Sarzni rok')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Sarzni rokovi')
        ordering = ['expiry_date']

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.inventory_item.name} - {self.batch_number} (exp: {self.expiry_date})'

    @property
    def days_until_expiry(self):
        from datetime import date
        return (self.expiry_date - date.today()).days

    @property
    def is_expired(self):
        return self.days_until_expiry < 0

    @property
    def is_warning(self):
        d = self.days_until_expiry
        return 0 <= d <= self.alert_days_before

class Voucher(models.Model):
    """Vaučer / Bon s određenom vrijednosti koji se koristi kao metoda plaćanja."""
    company = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='vouchers', verbose_name=_('Tvrtka'),
    )
    objects = CompanyManager()
    code            = models.CharField(max_length=20, unique=True, verbose_name=_('Kod vaučera'))
    original_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Izvorna vrijednost (€)'))
    remaining       = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Preostalo (€)'))
    expiry_date     = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Rok valjanosti'))
    is_active       = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name=_('Aktivan'))
    notes           = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Napomena'))
    created_by      = models.ForeignKey(
        User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='created_vouchers', verbose_name=_('Kreirao'),
    )
    created_at      = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Vaučer')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Vaučeri')
        ordering            = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.code} — {self.remaining}/{self.original_amount} EUR'

    @property
    def is_expired(self):
        if not self.expiry_date:
            return False
        from datetime import date
        return self.expiry_date < date.today()

    @property
    def is_usable(self):
        return self.is_active and not self.is_expired and self.remaining > 0

"""
AML — Anti-Money Laundering / Dubinska analiza klijenta.
Zakon o sprjecavanju pranja novca i financiranja terorizma (NN 108/17).
"""
from django.db import models
from django.conf import settings


class AMLRiskCategory(models.Model):
    """Kategorija rizika."""
    RISK_LEVELS = [
        ('low', 'Nizak'),
        ('medium', 'Srednji'),
        ('high', 'Visok'),
        ('very_high', 'Vrlo visok'),
    ]
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    risk_level = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=RISK_LEVELS)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['name']
        verbose_name = 'Kategorija rizika'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Kategorije rizika'

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.name} ({self.get_risk_level_display()})'


class AMLClientProfile(models.Model):
    """Profil dubinske analize klijenta."""
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('draft', 'Nacrt'),
        ('active', 'Aktivno'),
        ('review_needed', 'Potreban pregled'),
        ('expired', 'Isteklo'),
        ('archived', 'Arhivirano'),
    ]
    CLIENT_TYPE_CHOICES = [
        ('fizicka', 'Fizicka osoba'),
        ('pravna', 'Pravna osoba'),
    ]
    RISK_CHOICES = [
        ('low', 'Nizak'),
        ('medium', 'Srednji'),
        ('high', 'Visok'),
        ('very_high', 'Vrlo visok'),
    ]

    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                 related_name='aml_profiles')
    assessed_by = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                     null=True, related_name='aml_assessments')
    assessment_date = models.DateField()
    next_review_date = models.DateField()
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='draft')

    # Identifikacija
    client_type = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=CLIENT_TYPE_CHOICES, default='pravna')
    legal_form = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True,
        help_text='d.o.o., j.d.o.o., obrt, udruga, itd.')
    ownership_structure = models.TextField(blank=True,
        verbose_name='Vlasnička struktura')
    beneficial_owners = models.TextField(blank=True,
        verbose_name='Krajnji korisnici (stvarni vlasnici)')

    # Rizik
    risk_categories = models.ManyToManyField(AMLRiskCategory, blank=True)
    overall_risk = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=RISK_CHOICES, default='low')
    risk_score = models.IntegerField(default=0,
        help_text='0-100, automatski izracunat ili rucni')

    # Provjere
    id_verified = models.BooleanField(default=False,
        verbose_name='Osobna iskaznica provjerena')
    registry_checked = models.BooleanField(default=False,
        verbose_name='Sudski registar provjeren')
    pep_check = models.BooleanField(default=False,
        verbose_name='PEP provjera (politicki eksponirane osobe)')
    sanctions_check = models.BooleanField(default=False,
        verbose_name='Lista sankcija provjerena')
    adverse_media = models.BooleanField(default=False,
        verbose_name='Negativni medijski clanci provjereni')

    notes = models.TextField(blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-assessment_date']
        verbose_name = 'AML profil klijenta'
        verbose_name_plural = 'AML profili klijenata'

    def __str__(self):
        return f'AML: {self.company.name} ({self.get_overall_risk_display()})'

    @property
    def is_expired(self):
        from datetime import date
        return self.next_review_date < date.today()

    @property
    def checks_completed(self):
        checks = [self.id_verified, self.registry_checked, self.pep_check,
                   self.sanctions_check, self.adverse_media]
        return sum(checks), len(checks)

import uuid

from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Sum
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _

from companies.models import Company
from core.managers import CompanyManager


class Partner(models.Model):
    TYPE_CHOICES = [
        ('client',   _('Klijent (Kupac)')),
        ('supplier', _('Dobavljač')),
        ('both',     _('Partner (Oboje)')),
        ('employee', _('Zaposlenik')),
    ]

    class Country(models.TextChoices):
        HR = 'HR', _('Hrvatska')
        DE = 'DE', _('Njemačka')
        AT = 'AT', _('Austrija')
        SI = 'SI', _('Slovenija')
        BA = 'BA', _('Bosna i Hercegovina')
        RS = 'RS', _('Srbija')
        IT = 'IT', _('Italija')
        HU = 'HU', _('Mađarska')
        OTHER = 'OTHER', _('Ostalo')

    company = models.ForeignKey(Company, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='partners',
                                 verbose_name=_('Vlasnik podataka'))
    objects = CompanyManager()

    # Osnovni podaci
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200, verbose_name=_('Naziv / Ime'))
    oib  = models.CharField(max_length=13, blank=True, verbose_name=_('OIB / Steuer-Nr.'))

    # Lokacija
    address  = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Ulica i broj'))
    city     = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Grad'))
    zip_code = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Poštanski broj'))
    country  = models.CharField(
        max_length=10,
        choices=Country.choices,
        default=Country.HR,
        verbose_name=_('Država'),
    )

    # Kontakt
    email = models.EmailField(blank=True, verbose_name='Email')
    phone = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Telefon'))

    contact_person = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Kontakt osoba'))

    contact_email  = models.EmailField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Email kontakt osobe'))

    # Bankovni podaci
    iban  = models.CharField(max_length=34, blank=True, verbose_name='IBAN')
    swift = models.CharField(max_length=11, blank=True, verbose_name='SWIFT / BIC')

    # PDV
    is_vat_registered = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('U sustavu PDV-a'))

        max_length=20, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('PDV ID / VAT ID'),
        help_text=_('EU PDV identifikacijski broj (npr. HR12345678901)'),
    )

    # Komercijalni uvjeti
    partner_type   = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=TYPE_CHOICES, default='client',
                                       verbose_name=_('Tip partnera'))
    payment_term   = models.IntegerField(default=0, verbose_name=_('Rok plaćanja (dana)'))
    discount_percent = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0.00,
                                            verbose_name=_('Rabat (%)'))
    credit_limit   = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0,
                                          verbose_name=_('Kreditni limit'))

    # Sistem
    notes     = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Interne napomene'))
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name=_('Aktivan'))
    portal_token = models.UUIDField(unique=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)

    # AUTOMATIZACIJA (ne dira se ručno)
    cached_balance = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0.00,
                                          verbose_name=_('Saldo'))

        'companies.NKDCode',
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        verbose_name='NKD djelatnost',
    )

    class Meta:
        unique_together = ('company', 'oib')
        verbose_name = _('Partner')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Partneri')
        ordering = ['name']


    @property
    def is_complete(self):
        return bool(self.name and self.oib and self.address and self.city and self.email)

    @property
    def missing_fields(self):
        missing = []
        if not self.oib: missing.append("OIB")
        if not self.address: missing.append("Adresa")
        if not self.city: missing.append("Grad")
        if not self.email: missing.append("Email")
        if not self.phone: missing.append("Telefon")
        return missing
    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.name} ({self.city or 'N/A'})"

    def update_balance(self):
        inflow  = self.transactions.filter(direction='income').aggregate(Sum('amount'))['amount__sum'] or 0
        outflow = self.transactions.filter(direction='expense').aggregate(Sum('amount'))['amount__sum'] or 0
        self.cached_balance = inflow - outflow
        self.save(update_fields=['cached_balance'])

from decimal import Decimal
from django.utils import timezone as _tz


class GeminiUsageLog(models.Model):
    """Log svakog Gemini API poziva — budget kontrola i troškovni pregled."""
    caller        = models.CharField(max_length=100, db_index=True,
                        help_text="Modul koji je pozvao AI (invoice_text, smart_import...)")
    model         = models.CharField(max_length=60, default="gemini-2.0-flash")
    input_tokens  = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    output_tokens = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    cost_eur      = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=8, default=0)
    success       = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    input_hash    = models.CharField(max_length=16, blank=True)
    called_at     = models.DateTimeField(default=_tz.now, db_index=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = "Gemini poziv"
        verbose_name_plural = "Gemini pozivi"
        ordering            = ["-called_at"]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.called_at:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} | {self.caller} | {self.input_tokens}t | {'OK' if self.success else 'ERR'}"

    @classmethod
    def daily_summary(cls):
        from django.db.models import Sum, Count
        today = _tz.now().date()
        return cls.objects.filter(called_at__date=today).aggregate(
            total_calls=Count("id"),
            ok_calls=Count("id", filter=models.Q(success=True)),
            total_tokens=Sum("input_tokens"),
            total_cost=Sum("cost_eur"),
        )

class VideoGallery(models.Model):
    """
    Video galerija za viskovic-group.de.
    Podržava YouTube/Vimeo embed i direktni upload .mp4
    """
    KATEGORIJA_CHOICES = [
        ('bau',       'Visković BAU'),
        ('wildberg',  'Wildberg'),
        ('najam',     'VG Najam'),
        ('webshop',   'VG Shop'),
        ('projekt',   'Projekt reference'),
        ('tim',       'Tim / Ekipa'),
        ('ostalo',    'Ostalo'),
    ]

    naslov_hr   = models.CharField(max_length=200, verbose_name=_('Naslov (HR)'))
    naslov_de   = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Naslov (DE)'))
    naslov_en   = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Naslov (EN)'))
    opis_hr     = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Opis (HR)'))
    opis_de     = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Opis (DE)'))
    opis_en     = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('Opis (EN)'))

    # Video izvor — embed URL ili upload
    embed_url   = models.URLField(blank=True, verbose_name=_('YouTube / Vimeo URL'),
                                  help_text=_('Npr. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...'))
    video_file  = models.FileField(upload_to='website/videos/', null=True, blank=True,
                                   verbose_name=_('Video datoteka (.mp4)'))
    thumbnail   = models.ImageField(upload_to='website/video_thumbs/', null=True, blank=True,
                                    verbose_name=_('Thumbnail'))

    kategorija  = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=KATEGORIJA_CHOICES, default='ostalo',
                                   verbose_name=_('Kategorija'))
    trajanje    = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True, verbose_name=_('Trajanje'),
                                   help_text=_('Npr. 2:34'))
    redoslijed  = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0, verbose_name=_('Redoslijed'))
    is_active   = models.BooleanField(default=True, verbose_name=_('Aktivno'))
    is_featured = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Istaknuto'))
    created_at  = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = _('Video')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Video galerija')
        ordering            = ['redoslijed', '-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return self.naslov_hr or self.naslov_de or f'Video {self.id}'

    @property
    def embed_id(self):
        """Izvuče YouTube video ID iz URL-a"""
        import re
        if not self.embed_url:
            return None
        m = re.search(r'(?:v=|youtu\.be/)([\w-]{11})', self.embed_url)
        return m.group(1) if m else None

    @property
    def is_youtube(self):
        return 'youtube' in (self.embed_url or '') or 'youtu.be' in (self.embed_url or '')

    @property
    def is_vimeo(self):
        return 'vimeo' in (self.embed_url or '')

    @property
    def embed_src(self):
        """Vraća src za <iframe>"""
        if self.is_youtube and self.embed_id:
            return f'https://www.youtube.com/embed/{self.embed_id}'
        if self.is_vimeo:
            import re
            m = re.search(r'vimeo\.com/(\d+)', self.embed_url)
            if m:
                return f'https://player.vimeo.com/video/{m.group(1)}'
        return None

                               verbose_name=_('Fotografija'))

    # PDF datoteka
    pdf_file = models.FileField(upload_to='invoices/pdf/%Y/%m/', blank=True,
                                 verbose_name=_('PDF datoteka'))

    # Meta
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
                                    related_name='created_invoices')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'invoicing_invoice'
        verbose_name = _('Račun')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Računi')
        ordering = ['-date_issued']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.number} \u2013 {self.client_name} ({self.total} {self.currency})"

    def clean(self):
        from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
        from konto.models import AccountingPeriod
        if self.date_issued and hasattr(self, 'company') and self.company_id:
            if AccountingPeriod.is_period_locked(self.company, self.date_issued.year, self.date_issued.month):
                raise ValidationError(f"Razdoblje {self.date_issued.month:02d}/{self.date_issued.year} je zaključano. Izdavanje računa nije moguće.")

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        """
        Zakonska zaštita:
        1. Fiskalizirani/zaključani račun se ne smije mijenjati (ZOR čl.9, Zakon o fiskalizaciji)
        2. deletion_protected_until se automatski postavlja na datum_izdavanja + 11 godina (ZOR čl.10)
        """
        from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied

        # ── Guard: zaključani račun ──────────────────────────────────────────
        if self.pk:
            _uf = kwargs.get('update_fields')
            # Polja koja se smiju mijenjati čak i na zaključanom računu
            _safe_fields = {
                'qr_code_base64', 'pdf_file', 'photo', 'updated_at',
                'is_locked', 'deletion_protected_until', 'archive_hash',
                'jir', 'zki', 'is_fiscalized', 'fiscal_datetime',
                'operator_oib', 'issuer_phone',
            }
            if self.is_locked and _uf is not None and not set(_uf).issubset(_safe_fields):
                raise PermissionDenied(
                    f"Račun {self.number} je zaključan (fiskaliziran/arhiviran) "
                    f"i ne može se mijenjati. Izdajte Storno račun."
                )

        # ── Auto: postavi deletion_protected_until = datum + 11 godina ──────
        if not self.deletion_protected_until and self.date_issued:
            try:
                issued = self.date_issued
                if hasattr(issued, 'date'):
                    issued = issued.date()
                self.deletion_protected_until = issued.replace(year=issued.year + 11)
            except Exception:
                pass

        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def recalculate(self):
        from decimal import Decimal
        items = self.items.all()
        self.subtotal = sum(i.total_price for i in items)
        # Calculate tax from per-item tax_rate (not flat tax_percent)
        self.tax_amount = sum(
            i.total_price * i.tax_rate / Decimal('100')
            for i in items
        )
        self.total = self.subtotal + self.tax_amount
        return self

    @property
    def is_hr(self):
        return self.country == 'HR'

    @property
    def is_de(self):
        return self.country == 'DE'

    @property
    def effective_iban(self):
        """Uvijek vrati IBAN izdavatelja bez obzira na koji je field pohranjen.
        issuer_iban je canonical; iban je legacy field za stare zapise."""
        return self.issuer_iban or self.iban or ''

    @property
    def effective_swift(self):
        """Uvijek vrati SWIFT izdavatelja (issuer_swift > swift > prazan string)."""
        return self.issuer_swift or self.swift or ''


class InvoiceItem(models.Model):
    invoice      = models.ForeignKey(Invoice, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                      related_name='items', verbose_name=_('Račun'))
    description  = models.TextField(verbose_name=_('Opis'), default='')
    quantity     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=1, verbose_name=_('Količina'))
    unit         = models.CharField(max_length=10, default='kom', verbose_name=_('Jed.mjera'))
    unit_price   = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Jed.cijena'))
    discount_percent = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Popust %'))
    total_price  = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, verbose_name=_('Ukupno'))
    gross_total  = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0, verbose_name=_('Ukupno s PDV'))
    tax_rate     = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=25, verbose_name=_('PDV %'))

    # Normalizirana veza na TaxRate model
    tax_rate_obj = models.ForeignKey(
        'companies.TaxRate', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        verbose_name=_('PDV stopa'),
        help_text=_('Veza na poreznu stopu iz registra'),
    )

    # Veza na InventoryItem (opcionalno - za praćenje zaliha)
    inventory_item = models.ForeignKey(
        'inventory.InventoryItem', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='invoice_items',
        verbose_name=_('Artikl iz zalihe'),
    )

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'invoicing_invoiceitem'
        verbose_name = _('Stavka računa')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Stavke računa')

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.description} \xd7 {self.quantity} = {self.total_price}"

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        # Sync tax_rate from tax_rate_obj if set
        if self.tax_rate_obj_id and self.tax_rate_obj:
            self.tax_rate = self.tax_rate_obj.rate
        self.total_price = round(
            Decimal(str(self.quantity)) * Decimal(str(self.unit_price)) * (1 - Decimal(str(self.discount_percent)) / Decimal('100')), 2
        )
        self.gross_total = round(self.total_price * (1 + Decimal(str(self.tax_rate)) / Decimal('100')), 2)
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)




class InvoiceEvent(models.Model):
    """Audit trail — every action on an invoice is logged here for the Timeline."""
    EVENT_TYPES = [
        ('created', 'Dokument kreiran'),
        ('lookup', 'Lookup partnera'),
        ('vies_ok', 'VIES potvrda'),
        ('vies_fail', 'VIES negativan'),
        ('reverse_charge', 'Reverse Charge primijenjen'),
        ('item_added', 'Stavka dodana'),
        ('item_weighed', 'Stavka izvagana'),
        ('rollwagen_bound', 'Rollwagen vezan'),
        ('dispatched', 'Otpremljeno'),
        ('fiscalized', 'Fiskalizirano'),
        ('paid', 'Placeno'),
        ('storno_partial', 'Djelomicni storno'),
        ('storno_full', 'Potpuni storno'),
        ('sent_email', 'Poslano emailom'),
        ('sent_whatsapp', 'Poslano WhatsApp'),
        ('morphed', 'Dokument mutirao'),
        ('status_change', 'Promjena statusa'),
        ('edited', 'Izmjena podataka'),
        ('note', 'Biljeska'),
    ]
    invoice = models.ForeignKey(
        'Invoice', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='events',
    )
    event_type = models.CharField(max_length=30, choices=EVENT_TYPES)
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    detail = models.TextField(blank=True)
    metadata = models.JSONField(default=dict, blank=True)
    actor = models.ForeignKey(
        'auth.User', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
    )
    # ── Audit: tko je editirao, s kojeg uređaja ─────────────────────────────
    # ZOR čl. 9 + GoBD §147 — dokazivost svake izmjene
    updated_by = models.ForeignKey(
        'auth.User', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='invoice_events_updated',
        verbose_name='Izvršio izmjenu',
    )
    client_ip = models.GenericIPAddressField(
        null=True, blank=True,
        verbose_name='IP adresa',
        help_text='IP adresa korisnika koji je izvršio akciju',
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'invoicing_invoice_event'
        ordering = ['-created_at']
        verbose_name = 'Invoice Event'

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.event_type}: {self.title}"

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            'id': self.pk,
            'event_type': self.event_type,
            'title': self.title,
            'detail': self.detail,
            'metadata': self.metadata,
            'actor': self.actor.get_full_name() if self.actor else '',
            'created_at': self.created_at.isoformat() if self.created_at else '',
            'time_display': self.created_at.strftime('%H:%M') if self.created_at else '',
            'date_display': self.created_at.strftime('%d.%m.%Y') if self.created_at else '',
        }

class Project(models.Model):
    STATUS_CHOICES = [

        ('COMPLETED', 'Završen'), ('ARCHIVED', 'Arhiviran'),
    ]
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                null=True, blank=True, related_name='worktime_projects')
    objects = CompanyManager()

    code = models.CharField(max_length=20, unique=True)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    client_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='ACTIVE')
    hourly_rate = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal('25.00'))
    is_billable = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    budget_hours = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True,
                                        help_text='Budžet u satima')
    color = models.CharField(max_length=7, default='#3b82f6', help_text='HEX boja za prikaz')
    work_group = models.ForeignKey(WorkGroup, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                    null=True, blank=True, related_name='projects')
    members = models.ManyToManyField(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, blank=True,
                                      related_name='assigned_projects')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"[{self.code}] {self.name}"

    @property
    def hours_used(self):
        return self.time_entries.aggregate(s=models.Sum('duration'))['s'] or Decimal('0')

    @property
    def budget_percentage(self):
        if not self.budget_hours or self.budget_hours == 0:
            return 0
        return min(100, round(float(self.hours_used) / float(self.budget_hours) * 100, 1))

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['name']

class TimeEntry(models.Model):
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('DRAFT', 'Skica'), ('PENDING', 'Na čekanju'),
        ('APPROVED', 'Odobreno'), ('REJECTED', 'Odbijeno'),
    ]
    TASK_TYPES = [
        ('DEVELOPMENT', 'Razvoj'), ('DESIGN', 'Dizajn'),
        ('MEETING', 'Sastanak'), ('SUPPORT', 'Podrška'),
        ('ADMIN', 'Administracija'), ('TESTING', 'Testiranje'),
        ('PLANNING', 'Planiranje'), ('TRAINING', 'Edukacija'),
        ('TRAVEL', 'Putovanje'), ('OTHER', 'Ostalo'),
    ]

                                null=True, blank=True, related_name='time_entries')
    objects = CompanyManager()

    user = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                              related_name='time_entries')
    project = models.ForeignKey(Project, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='time_entries')
    date = models.DateField(db_index=True)
    start_time = models.TimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    end_time = models.TimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    duration = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2,
                                    validators=[MinValueValidator(Decimal('0.01'))])
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    task_type = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=TASK_TYPES, default='DEVELOPMENT')
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='PENDING')
    billing_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal('0'))
    is_billed = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    is_overtime = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    invoice = models.ForeignKey('invoicing.Invoice', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                 null=True, blank=True, related_name='time_entries')
    project_lead = models.ForeignKey('burza.ProjectLead', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                      null=True, blank=True, related_name='time_entries',
                                      verbose_name='Burza projekt')
    approved_by = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                     null=True, blank=True, related_name='approved_entries')
    approved_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    rejection_reason = models.TextField(blank=True, verbose_name='Razlog odbijanja')
    tags = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, help_text='Tagovi odvojeni zarezom')
    from_timer = models.BooleanField(default=False, help_text='Kreirano putem štoperice')

    # ── Zakonski podaci (HR Pravilnik NN 55/24 + DE ArbZG/ArbSchG) ──────────
    ABSENCE_TYPES = [
        ('',          '—'),
        ('ANNUAL',    'Godišnji odmor / Jahresurlaub'),
        ('SICK',      'Bolovanje / Krankheit'),
        ('PAID',      'Plaćeni dopust / Bezahlter Sonderurlaub'),
        ('UNPAID',    'Neplaćeni dopust / Unbezahlter Urlaub'),
        ('HOLIDAY',   'Blagdan / Feiertag'),
        ('PATERNITY', 'Očinski dopust / Vaterschaftsurlaub'),
        ('CARE',      'Dopust za njegu / Pflegeurlaub'),
        ('MILITARY',  'Vojna obveza / Wehrdienst'),
        ('ELECTION',  'Izborna odsutnost / Wahlkampf'),
        ('STRIKE',    'Štrajk / Streik'),
        ('LOCKOUT',   'Isključenje / Aussperrung'),
        ('UNJUSTIFIED','Neopravdani izostanak / Unentschuldigtes Fehlen'),
        ('STOPPAGE',  'Zastoj/krivnja poslodavca / Betriebsstörung'),
        ('OTHER',     'Ostalo / Sonstiges'),
    ]
    absence_type   = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=ABSENCE_TYPES, blank=True, default='',
                                       verbose_name='Vrsta odsutnosti / Abwesenheitsart')
    is_night_work  = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name='Noćni rad / Nachtarbeit')
    is_holiday_work= models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name='Rad na blagdan / Feiertagsarbeit')
    # ── Payroll izračun (auto-popunjava save()) ──────────────────
    regular_hours  = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal('0'),
                                         verbose_name='Redovni sati / Reguläre Stunden')
    overtime_hours = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal('0'),
                                         verbose_name='Prekovremeni / Überstunden')
    night_hours    = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal('0'),
                                         verbose_name='Noćni sati / Nachtstunden')
    compliance_note = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, default='',
                                        verbose_name='Zakonsko upozorenje / Compliance')

    break_minutes  = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(default=0,
                                                       verbose_name='Pauza (min) / Pause (Min)')
    daily_rest_hours = models.DecimalField(max_digits=4, decimal_places=1, null=True, blank=True,
                                            verbose_name='Dnevni odmor (h) / Ruhezeit (h)')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)


    def calculate_payroll(self):
        """Auto-split hours into regular/overtime/night. Efficient interval math."""
        import datetime as _dt
        dur = self.duration or Decimal('0')

        # Regular vs overtime (threshold from EmployeeProfile or 8h default)
        try:
            emp = self.user.employeeprofile
            daily_limit = emp.daily_hours or Decimal('8')
            base_rate = emp.hourly_rate or Decimal('20')
            ot_rate = emp.overtime_rate or Decimal('30')
        except Exception:
            daily_limit = Decimal('8')
            base_rate = Decimal('20')
            ot_rate = Decimal('30')

        if dur > daily_limit:
            self.regular_hours = daily_limit
            self.overtime_hours = dur - daily_limit
            self.is_overtime = True
        else:
            self.regular_hours = dur
            self.overtime_hours = Decimal('0')

        # Night hours — interval overlap math (22:00-06:00), no minute-loop
        night = Decimal('0')
        if self.start_time and self.end_time:
            dummy = _dt.date(2000, 1, 1)
            s = _dt.datetime.combine(dummy, self.start_time)
            e = _dt.datetime.combine(dummy, self.end_time)
            if e <= s:
                e += _dt.timedelta(days=1)
            total_minutes = (e - s).total_seconds() / 60

            # Night windows: 00:00-06:00 (day 0), 22:00-24:00 (day 0), 00:00-06:00 (day 1)
            night_ranges = [
                (_dt.datetime(2000, 1, 1, 0, 0), _dt.datetime(2000, 1, 1, 6, 0)),
                (_dt.datetime(2000, 1, 1, 22, 0), _dt.datetime(2000, 1, 2, 0, 0)),
                (_dt.datetime(2000, 1, 2, 0, 0), _dt.datetime(2000, 1, 2, 6, 0)),
            ]
            night_mins = 0
            for ns, ne in night_ranges:
                overlap_start = max(s, ns)
                overlap_end = min(e, ne)
                if overlap_start < overlap_end:
                    night_mins += (overlap_end - overlap_start).total_seconds() / 60
            night = Decimal(str(round(night_mins / 60, 2)))

        self.night_hours = night
        if night > 0:
            self.is_night_work = True

        # Billing amount
        night_bonus = base_rate * Decimal('0.25')
        self.billing_amount = (
            self.regular_hours * base_rate
            + self.overtime_hours * ot_rate
            + self.night_hours * night_bonus
        )

        # Compliance checks (ArbZG §3 / ZOR čl.65)
        warnings = []
        if dur > Decimal('10'):
            warnings.append('ArbZG §3: >10h rada')
        if dur > Decimal('12'):
            warnings.append('KRITIČNO: >12h rada')
        if self.break_minutes < 30 and dur >= Decimal('6'):
            warnings.append('ArbZG §4: pauza <30min za 6+h')
        if self.break_minutes < 45 and dur >= Decimal('9'):
            warnings.append('ArbZG §4: pauza <45min za 9+h')
        self.compliance_note = '; '.join(warnings)

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.duration and self.duration > 0 and not self.absence_type:
            self.calculate_payroll()
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.user.username} | {self.project.code} | {self.date} | {self.duration}h"

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-date', '-start_time']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['user', 'date']),
            models.Index(fields=['project', 'date']),
            models.Index(fields=['status']),
        ]


class ActiveTimer(models.Model):
    """Aktivna štoperica - jedan korisnik može imati samo jedan aktivan timer"""
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('RUNNING', 'Aktivan'),
        ('PAUSED', 'Pauziran'),
    ]
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                null=True, blank=True, related_name='active_timers')
    objects = CompanyManager()

    user = models.OneToOneField(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                 related_name='active_timer')
    project = models.ForeignKey(Project, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    project_lead = models.ForeignKey('burza.ProjectLead', on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                      null=True, blank=True, related_name='active_timers',
                                      verbose_name='Burza projekt')
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    task_type = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=TimeEntry.TASK_TYPES, default='DEVELOPMENT')
    status = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='RUNNING')
    started_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    paused_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    accumulated_seconds = models.IntegerField(default=0,
        help_text='Akumulirane sekunde iz prethodnih pauza')
    tags = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    @property
    def elapsed_seconds(self):
        if self.status == 'PAUSED':
            return self.accumulated_seconds
        now = timezone.now()
        running = int((now - self.started_at).total_seconds())
        return self.accumulated_seconds + running

    @property
    def elapsed_display(self):
        total = self.elapsed_seconds
        hours = total // 3600
        minutes = (total % 3600) // 60
        seconds = total % 60
        return f"{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}:{seconds:02d}"

    @property
    def elapsed_hours(self):
        return Decimal(str(round(self.elapsed_seconds / 3600, 2)))

    def pause(self):
        if self.status == 'RUNNING':
            now = timezone.now()
            running = int((now - self.started_at).total_seconds())
            self.accumulated_seconds += running
            self.paused_at = now
            self.status = 'PAUSED'
            self.save()

    def resume(self):
        if self.status == 'PAUSED':
            self.started_at = timezone.now()
            self.paused_at = None
            self.status = 'RUNNING'
            self.save()

    def stop_and_save(self):
        duration = self.elapsed_hours
        if duration < Decimal('0.01'):
            duration = Decimal('0.01')
        now = timezone.now()
        entry_date = self.created_at.date()
        start_time = self.created_at.time()
        end_time = now.time()
        try:
            rate = self.user.employeeprofile.hourly_rate
        except Exception:
            rate = self.project.hourly_rate
        billing = duration * rate if self.project.is_billable else Decimal('0')
        entry = TimeEntry.objects.create(
            company=self.company,
            user=self.user, project=self.project, date=entry_date,
            start_time=start_time, end_time=end_time, duration=duration,
            description=self.description, task_type=self.task_type,
            status='PENDING', billing_amount=billing,
            from_timer=True, tags=self.tags,
            project_lead=self.project_lead,
        )
        self.delete()
        return entry

    def discard(self):
        self.delete()

    def __str__(self):
        return f"⏱ {self.user.username} | {self.project.code} | {self.elapsed_display}"

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'Aktivna štoperica'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Aktivne štoperice'

class TimeLog(models.Model):
    """Physical clock-in/clock-out log with GPS verification."""
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('OPEN', 'Aktivna smjena'),
        ('CLOSED', 'Zatvorena'),
        ('FLAGGED', 'Zastavica'),
    ]
    company = models.ForeignKey('companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                null=True, blank=True, related_name='time_logs')
    user = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                             related_name='time_logs')
    start_time = models.DateTimeField()
    end_time = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    date = models.DateField(db_index=True)

    # GPS at clock-in/out
    clock_in_lat = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True)
    clock_in_lon = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True)
    clock_out_lat = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True)
    clock_out_lon = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True)
    clock_in_distance = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True,
        help_text='Udaljenost od firme pri prijavi (m)')
    clock_out_distance = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True,
        help_text='Udaljenost od firme pri odjavi (m)')

    # Calculated fields
    gross_hours = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='Bruto sati (bez odbitka)')
    break_minutes = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(default=0,
        verbose_name='ArbZG pauza (min)')
    payable_hours = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=0,
        verbose_name='Neto sati za placu')

    status = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='OPEN')
    is_audited = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    audit_flag = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True,
        help_text='Revizorska zastavica')
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True)

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'worktime_timelog'
        ordering = ['-date', '-start_time']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['user', 'date']),
            models.Index(fields=['status']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.user.username} | {self.date} | {self.gross_hours}h"

    def calculate_arbzg_break(self):
        """
        ArbZG section 4 — mandatory break deduction:
        - 6-9 hours work: 30 min break
        - >9 hours work: 45 min break
        - <=6 hours: no mandatory break
        """
        if self.gross_hours <= 6:
            return 0
        elif self.gross_hours <= 9:
            return 30
        else:
            return 45

    def close_shift(self):
        """Close shift, calculate ArbZG break, compute payable hours."""
        if not self.end_time or not self.start_time:
            return
        delta = self.end_time - self.start_time
        self.gross_hours = Decimal(str(round(delta.total_seconds() / 3600, 2)))
        self.break_minutes = self.calculate_arbzg_break()
        break_hours = Decimal(str(self.break_minutes)) / Decimal('60')
        self.payable_hours = self.gross_hours - break_hours
        if self.payable_hours < 0:
            self.payable_hours = Decimal('0')
        self.status = 'CLOSED'
        self.save()

class TravelOrder(models.Model):
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ("draft", "Nacrt"),
        ("approved", "Odobren"),
        ("completed", "Završen"),
        ("cancelled", "Otkazan"),
    ]
    TRANSPORT_CHOICES = [
        ("car_personal", "Osobni automobil"),
        ("car_company", "Službeni automobil"),
        ("bus", "Autobus"),
        ("train", "Vlak"),
        ("plane", "Avion"),
        ("other", "Ostalo"),
    ]
    company = models.ForeignKey("companies.Company", on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                null=True, blank=True, related_name="travel_orders")
    objects = CompanyManager()
    employee = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                                 related_name="travel_orders")
    order_number = models.CharField(max_length=50)  # PN-2026-0001

    destination = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    purpose = models.TextField()

    departure_date = models.DateTimeField()
    return_date = models.DateTimeField()

    transport_type = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=TRANSPORT_CHOICES, default="car_personal")

    # Costs
    distance_km = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=1, default=0)
    per_diem_rate = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal("26.55"))
    per_diem_days = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=1, default=0)
    per_diem_total = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    mileage_rate = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal("0.40"))
    mileage_total = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    other_costs = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total_cost = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)

    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default="draft")
    approved_by = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
                                    null=True, blank=True, related_name="approved_travel_orders")
    approved_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    notes = models.TextField(blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["-departure_date"]
        unique_together = [["company", "order_number"]]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.order_number} - {self.destination}"

    def calculate_costs(self):
        self.per_diem_total = self.per_diem_days * self.per_diem_rate
        self.mileage_total = self.distance_km * self.mileage_rate
        self.total_cost = self.per_diem_total + self.mileage_total + self.other_costs

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.calculate_costs()
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    @staticmethod
    def next_order_number(company):
        year = timezone.now().year
        last = TravelOrder.objects.filter(
            company=company,
            order_number__startswith=f"PN-{year}-"
        ).order_by("-order_number").first()
        if last:
            try:
                num = int(last.order_number.split("-")[-1]) + 1
            except (ValueError, IndexError):
                num = 1
        else:
            num = 1
        return f"PN-{year}-{num:04d}"

"""FiscalConfig – per-company FINA certificate configuration."""
import base64
import os
import hashlib

from cryptography.fernet import Fernet
from django.conf import settings
from django.db import models


def _fernet():
    """Derive a Fernet key from Django SECRET_KEY."""
    key = hashlib.sha256(settings.SECRET_KEY.encode()).digest()
    return Fernet(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(key))


class FiscalConfig(models.Model):
    """
    FINA digitalni certifikat i konfiguracija fiskalizacije po tvrtki.
    Certifikat (.p12) se sprema u /var/www/fina-connect/certs/
    Lozinka je Fernet-enkriptirana (ključ = SHA256(SECRET_KEY)).
    """
    company = models.OneToOneField(
        'companies.Company', on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='fiscal_config', verbose_name='Tvrtka',
    )
    cert_filename    = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True,
                                        verbose_name='Naziv .p12 datoteke')
    _cert_password   = models.BinaryField(null=True, blank=True,
                                           db_column='cert_password',
                                           verbose_name='Lozinka (enkriptirana)')
    ozn_pos_pr       = models.CharField(max_length=20, default='1',
                                         verbose_name='Oznaka poslovnog prostora')
    ozn_nap_ur       = models.CharField(max_length=20, default='1',
                                         verbose_name='Oznaka naplatnog uređaja')
    is_demo          = models.BooleanField(default=True,
                                            verbose_name='Demo način (CIS test)')
    is_active        = models.BooleanField(default=False,
                                            verbose_name='Fiskalizacija aktivna')
    last_test_at     = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True,
                                             verbose_name='Zadnji test')
    last_test_ok     = models.BooleanField(null=True, blank=True,
                                            verbose_name='Zadnji test OK')
    created_at       = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at       = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name        = 'Konfiguracija fiskalizacije'
        verbose_name_plural = 'Konfiguracije fiskalizacije'

    def __str__(self):
        status = 'AKTIVAN' if self.is_active else 'neaktivan'
        mode   = 'DEMO' if self.is_demo else 'PRODUKCIJA'
        return f'{self.company.name} – {status} ({mode})'

    def set_password(self, raw: str):
        if raw:
            self._cert_password = _fernet().encrypt(raw.encode())
        else:
            self._cert_password = None

    def get_password(self) -> str:
        if self._cert_password:
            return _fernet().decrypt(bytes(self._cert_password)).decode()
        return ''

    @property
    def cert_path(self) -> str | None:
        if not self.cert_filename:
            return None
        import os
        return os.path.join(settings.BASE_DIR, 'certs', self.cert_filename)

    @property
    def cert_exists(self) -> bool:
        p = self.cert_path
        return bool(p and os.path.isfile(p))

        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['seller_company', 'is_available']),
            models.Index(fields=['category', 'is_available']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.name} — {self.seller_company.name}"

    @property
    def is_in_season(self):
        if not self.seasonal_from and not self.seasonal_until:
            return True
        today = timezone.now().date()
        if self.seasonal_from and today < self.seasonal_from:
            return False
        if self.seasonal_until and today > self.seasonal_until:
            return False
        return True

    confirmed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    delivered_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    # Recurring orders
    is_recurring = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_("Ponavljajuca narudzba"))
    recurring_interval = models.CharField(

        choices=[

    DELIVERY_METHOD_CHOICES = [
        ('standard', _('Standardna dostava')),
        ('express', _('Express dostava')),
        ('gepek_taxi', _('Gepek / Taxi — hitno')),
        ('pickup', _('Osobno preuzimanje')),
    ]
    delivery_method = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=DELIVERY_METHOD_CHOICES,
        default='standard', verbose_name=_('Nacin dostave')
    )
    requires_cold_chain = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Zahtijeva hladni lanac'))
    cutoff_acknowledged = models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name=_('Cut-off potvrden'))

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('Narudžba tržnice')
        verbose_name_plural = _('Narudžbe tržnice')
        ordering = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.order_number} — {self.buyer_company.name}"

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self.order_number:
            year = timezone.now().year
            last = MarketplaceOrder.objects.filter(
                order_number__startswith=f"MKT-{year}-"
            ).count()
            self.order_number = f"MKT-{year}-{last + 1:05d}"
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def recalculate(self):
        self.subtotal = sum(i.total for i in self.items.all())
        self.total = self.subtotal + self.delivery_fee
        self.save(update_fields=['subtotal', 'total'])


class MarketplaceOrderItem(models.Model):
    """Stavka narudžbe - veže se na proizvod i na OPG."""
    SELLER_STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('pending', _('Čeka potvrdu')),
        ('confirmed', _('Potvrđeno')),
        ('preparing', _('U pripremi')),
        ('ready', _('Spremno')),
